jobs.title: Finance Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Finance Project Coordinator

**Location:** Hybrid (Culver City)

**Department:** Finance

**Reports to:** Director of Finance

**About the job**

* LA based preferred, able to work a hybrid schedule with office hours in Culver City, CA.
* Applications must include a portfolio link, including password if applicable, for consideration

 **Infinity Marketing Team**


A fully integrated and award winning marketing, event, and promotion agency, Infinity Marketing Team (IMT) creates and executes campaigns designed specifically for each of our clients’ brand objectives. With unparalleled expertise in event executions, exhibit environments, mobile marketing tours, digital marketing, event furnishings, and brand marketing strategies, IMT offers numerous means for our clients to achieve premium outcomes. We Create. We Implement. We Show Results!


From spectacular filmed and streamed event productions to jaw\-dropping international conferences and tradeshow displays to globally recognized mobile marketing tours and influencer crossovers, IMT uses an infinite realm of methods to assist companies in strengthening their brands and enhancing their voices in the marketplace. In over 10,000 event marketing campaigns, IMT maintains our guiding belief \- there are no boundaries and there are no limits.

**About the Role**


The Finance Project Coordinator is responsible for financial management of experiential marketing projects including oversight of revenue recognition, financial reporting, forecasting, and process compliance. The Project Finance Coordinator will function as the Business liaison on larger or more complex projects or clients including contract and pricing negotiations (with oversight).

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Client Servicing**

* Coordinate data collection for client audits
* Communicate with internal project teams regarding budgets, billing, and accounts receivable issues
* Maintain catalog of required client reporting and ensure timely completion

**Financial Management and Planning**

* Support project teams in building and entering client budgets, responding to RFP’s and developing budgets (with oversight)
* Ensure that projects are managed in accordance with contracts; create summary sheets for account and project teams
* Ensure written client agreements are obtained (via contract, letter of agreement, signed SOW, etc.) for all work and are appropriately archived and classified. Liaise with Contract Specialists and Legal.
* Assist project teams with monthly project budget to actual tracking and other required client reporting
* Review and approve scopes and staffing plans; escalate issues to finance lead as appropriate.
* Review monthly fee and expense details. Analyze accuracy and explain significant variances to budget or forecast
* Prepare management reports and identify and communicate areas of concern and suggested improvements to project staff and management (e.g., client profitability, utilization, over/under service, missing time, revenue risk and staffing plans)
* Facilitate monthly billing liaison between project team and finance/accounting department and review billing reports
* Review time and expense write\-offs and unbilled WIP
* Work with project team to minimize risk exposure surrounding accounts receivables and credit requirements of clients
* Accountable for timely and valuable AR collection status commentary and liaison with Accounts Receivable
* Supervise project set up process for project team and perform finance liaison role for larger or more complex projects.
* Drive profitability by working with accounts, production, and management
* Review staffing utilization, realization, and capacity and proactively communicate meaningful observations with leaders
* Ensure compliance with company financial policies (e.g., revenue recognition, project requisitions, time entry, travel and expense, credit, billing, accounts payable, new business)
* Ad hoc requests and projects

**Qualifications**

* The ideal candidate will have a Bachelor’s Degree in Finance or Accounting with two years of Finance or Accounting experience preferred.
* Advanced Microsoft Office skills.

**Preferred Knowledge And Skills**

* The ideal candidate will have excellent written, oral, and interpersonal communication skills, be client service oriented and foster positive working relationships.
* Is well organized with strong time management skills and attention to detail, follows through on multiple projects and juggle conflicting priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* The candidate will also possess strong financial analysis and management skills, good business acumen, ability to articulate financial concerns in layman’s terms, and be a self\-starter and initiative taker.
* Advanced knowledge of financial systems.

**What We Offer**

* Competitive salary and benefits
* Paid holidays, PTO, and recovery days
* Opportunities for career growth and creative collaboration
* A culture that values inclusivity, hustle, fun, and innovation

jobs.title: Administrative College & Clinical Education Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**JOB TITLE:** Administrative College \& Clinical Education Operations Coordinator

**DEPARTMENT:** College of Health Professions

**LOCATION:** Hybrid \- On\-campus (80% \- 4 days) and Remote (20% \- 1 day)

**FSLA STATUS:** Non\-exempt

**REPORTS TO:** Dean of College of Health Professions

**COMPENSATION:** $27\.50/Hour

**GENERAL PURPOSE OF THE JOB:**

This position is primarily responsible for coordinating day\-to\-day administrative tasks for the College of Health Professions and dedicated to the Dean by performing the following duties.

**POSITION SUMMARY:**

The Coordinator ensures efficient operation for the College of Health Professions by providing administrative and project management support for the college and programs, including clinical operations and contract management support for programs and the Dean. This role will include coordination of activities with other departments or programs, administrative support to faculty and staff, HR related activities, data collection and review, preparation of reports, committee work, student support, updating of web pages and catalog sections, event and meeting coordination, etc. This requires interaction with Evidence in Motion to manage and obtain signatures on affiliation agreements for programs within the College of Health Professions, including certificates of liability. This is an active role, which involves dealing with a wide range of matters, sometimes of a confidential nature and requires attention to detail, organization, interpersonal and communication skills. The coordinator must be able to multitask and prioritize effectively, work with tight deadlines, and learn new systems and procedures rapidly.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Dean Support**

* Manage the calendar of the Dean.
* Support the Dean in the management \& completion of various University processes to agreed deadlines.
* Reports on status of college, departmental and University projects.
* Coordinates meeting requests with internal and external entities.
* Records minutes for meetings conducted by the Dean, Program Dean/Director.
* Works with the Dean/Directors to prepare and track all business transactions pertinent to the college activity including purchase orders (PO), check requests, and Memoranda of Understanding (MOU).
* Completes all clinical education affiliation agreement routing for the College of Health Professions through SCU internal offices for review and signature.
* Enters and manages clinical education agreements within EXXAT database.
* Works directly with the Evidence in Motion Clinical Operations team to manage clinical education processes and agreements.
* Plans, organizes, and coordinates travel arrangements for the Dean.
* Provides support for all program accreditations.
* Assists in the development of the annual budget, monitors college budget expenditures, creates reports as needed.
* Acts as liaison between Dean/Director and faculty, staff, students, University departments, and outside agencies and organizations.
* Coordinates special projects and events as needed.
* Utilizes feedback to improve college processes.

**Faculty Support**

* Ensures faculty data is complete and accurate in all databases and platforms.
* Coordinates and monitors attendance and grade submission to meet university deadlines.
* Supports the directors of clinical education and academic fieldwork coordinators in clinical education agreement management and signature procurement.

**College Support**

* Responsible for the coordination/completion and the quality of the clerical work for the college.
* Performs and coordinates scheduling tasks and support services associated with preparing and making arrangements for and assisting with on\-campus events, meetings, conferences, travel, or other related duties.
* Represents the college at events such as orientation, first day of classes, graduation and other ceremonies, symposia, examination weeks, etc.
* Manage the college academic calendar and communicates key dates through MySCU, Canvas, and the university academic calendar (when indicated).
* Assists in the preparation of status and technical reports and documents (Accreditation, book adoptions, student rosters, etc.).
* Maintains confidential records and files (paper and electronic).
* Monitors and maintains an inventory of durable and non\-durable inventory, supplies, and capital equipment, monitors functionality and expiration dates and plans for equipment replacement.
* Assist with purchasing requirements including obtaining vendor price quotes, requisitions for purchase, initiates and communicates with the purchasing department.
* Monitors for accuracy and updates portions of the academic catalog (Acalog), handbooks, website, MySCU, faculty/staff email lists, and other publications.
* Coordinates curriculum revision projects and ensures accuracy of data in course information systems (Canvas, Curriculog, J1\).
* Assists in managing and updating academic platforms and databases such as Canvas, J1, Teams, MySCU, ExamSoft, Interfolio, Curriculog, Electronic Student Academic Records, and program specific databases.
* Monitors and guides the completion of college projects and assignments.
* Manage the college academic calendar and communicates key dates through MySCU, Canvas, and the university academic calendar (when indicated).
* Coordinates the development of annual and term program and examination schedules, faculty and room assignments, and inputs data into schedule management system (Coursedog).
* Informs faculty, staff, and students of changes in the schedule; manages all processes related to the changes in courses offered in a term.
* Provides information related to university and college policies, processes, and deadlines, and directs individuals to sources of additional information.
* Maintains college book lists and coordinates updates through the curriculum management system
* (Curriculog), compliance reports, and communication with the LRC.

jobs.title: Health Program Coordinator
jobs.description:
Healthcare Staffing Professionals has an immediate need for a Health Program Coordinator. HPC duties must comply with established Department of Public Health (DPH) policies procedures, state and local laws, ordinances, and regulations for the control of communicable disease. HPC must maintain client confidentiality requirement per the Health Insurance Portability Accountability Act (HIPAA). In addition, staff must adhere to LAC DPH, and Protected Health Information, procedure, policies, and ordinance pertaining to HIV Security and Confidentiality laws and trainings.



The Division of HIV and STD Programs (DHSP) Health Program Coordinator (HPC) plans, coordinates, and implements public health programming by providing direct services in the field, developing and monitoring management and logistical processes, assists Public Health Investigators (PHIs) for the control of communicable diseases with special focus on HIV and STIs. Assignments may include but not limited to linking clients to HIV care and syphilis treatment, conducting specialized CDR interviews with clients, transporting clients to high priority medical appointments, conducting chart reviews, providing Field Delivered Therapy (FDT), collaborating with other Direct Community Services (DCS) programs to implement field based/mobile testing services. The HPC supports data management efforts including data entry, data quality assurance, analyzing HIV and syphilis labs, and collaborating with surveillance units. The HPC will lead planning and logistics for outreach events for special initiatives and DCS programs.



The positions will start immediately upon acceptance and employment clearance and are initially funded through 8/31/27, with the good chance of extension.


**Pay Rate:** $30\.24/hr working 40 hours a week


**Location**: Hybrid 2 days a week in office. Telework/Field works the remaining days.


**Benefits**: Paid Holidays, Paid Sick Time, PTO


**Healthcare**: Employer Fully Funded Healthcare (Anthem Blue Cross), Dental and Vision, Life Insurance from Initial


**Job Duties:**

* Activities include but are not limited to conducting linkage to care, treatment, biomedical prevention, or other essential services for priority clients/contacts; conduct Cluster Detection and Response (CDR) enhanced re\-interviews; support case investigation and documentation; analyze HIV and STI case information to develop and implement timely disease intervention plans; complete treatment verification and chart reviews; counsel and educate clients on risk\-reduction and prevention strategies; provide FDT and other supplies such as self\-test kits, condoms, harm reduction items.
* Develop tracking plans, service reports, and scopes of work to ensure goals are met.
* Coordinate outreach activities to support DCS program efforts. Lead logistical activities to prepare and report event outcomes. Support testing events as the mobile unit driver, on\-site coordinator, working with venue partners.
* Perform other duties, as assigned, within the scope of a Health Program Coordinator at DHSP.
* Perform other duties, as assigned, within the scope of a Health Program Coordinator at DHSP.


**Qualifications:**

* Four years of experience in planning and implementing organized community programs and activities in public or community health, delinquency prevention, community relations, or community welfare. Graduation from an accredited college or university with a degree in public health will be accepted for one year of the required experience.
* A valid California Class C Driver License or the ability to utilize an alternative method of transportation when needed to carry out job\-related essential functions.
* Thorough knowledge of HIV and STI testing, biomedical prevention, and treatment protocols.
* Knowledge of HIV/STI, drug treatment, mental health, housing service programs.
* Ability to complete HIV/STI counseling and testing training and certification.
* Knowledge of and experience with HIV/STI labs, data, data systems, and quality assurance standards.
* Strong outreach skills.
* Strong organizational and interpersonal skills.
* Excellent leadership and communication skills (verbal and written).
* Knowledge with Microsoft Word, Access, Excel, Power\-point, and ability to learn internal data systems.
* Able to participate in field\-based services.
* **Preferable**: Bilingual Spanish

jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Warehouse Operations Coordinator**

**Location:** Carson, CA  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Department:** Operations  
**Reports To:** Operations/Customer Service

**Pay:** $20\-25/hour

**About us**

bellicon America LLC is part of the international bellicon Group – the leading manufacturer of premium mini\-trampolines.  From our logistics center in Los Angeles, we ship our products to customers all over US.

**Position Overview**

The Warehouse Operations Coordinator plays a key role in overseeing daily warehouse workflows, ensuring operational accuracy, and supporting management in achieving performance targets. This position is responsible for planning, steering, and monitoring warehouse operations while working closely with management and warehouse associates. The coordinator ensures quality standards are met, documentation is precise, and all warehouse processes run efficiently and effectively.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Warehouse operations planning — Plans, steers, and monitors warehouse operations.
* Management communication — Interfaces with management and customer service, communicating via Teams.
* Target implementation — Reviews management’s targets and develops the implementation plan in close coordination with the Warehouse Team Lead; execution on the floor sits with the Team Lead.
* Quality control — Assigns quality checks to the Warehouse Team Lead and documents the results.
* Operational reporting — Writes daily and weekly reports to management.
* Operational support — Provides hand on assistance, as needed, including picking and packing bellicon trampolines and other small parts/items.
* Returns processing — Handles returns and books them in NAV; physical return work is performed by a warehouse associate.
* Inventory documentation — Maintains accurate records within Microsoft Dynamics NAV (Navision).
* Supplier \& logistics coordination — Coordinates with suppliers and freight forwarders regarding shipments, deliveries, and inventory movements.
* Purchase order management — Creates and manages purchase orders and supplier claims.
* Warehouse administrative support — Supports warehouse operations with administrative and logistical tasks as needed.
* Internal collaboration — Collaborates with internal teams to ensure efficient order fulfillment and inventory management.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Minimum 1\-2 years of experience in order processing, operations, logistics, customer service or a related role.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Ability to multitask and prioritize effectively in a fast\-paced environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, and Word.
* Professional and operations\-focused attitude.
* Attention to detail in documentation and quality checks
* Able to stand/sit for long periods of time and lift up to 50 lbs.

**Preferred**

* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics NAV (Navision) or similar ERP systems.
* Experience leading or coordinating warehouse staff
* Knowledge of shipping, logistics, and warehouse operations.
* Interest in health, wellness, fitness, or premium consumer products.

**Skills \& Competencies**

* Demonstrates strong problem‑solving abilities and can resolve operational challenges effectively.
* Manages time efficiently and maintains productivity in a fast‑paced warehouse environment.
* Works independently while also contributing effectively as part of a team.
* Maintains a high level of accuracy and attention to detail in documentation and quality checks.
* Adapts quickly to changing priorities and takes a proactive approach to responsibilities.
* Communicates clearly with management, team leads, and suppliers to ensure smooth operations.
* Applies operational leadership skills to coordinate warehouse staff and oversee daily workflows.
* Utilizes ERP systems (NAV preferred) confidently to manage inventory and returns.

**What We Offer**

* A stable job in a growing international company
* Fair pay and regular working hours
* A friendly, supportive team and a positive work environment
* Clear structures and modern workspace
* Employee discounts on bellicon® products

**Benefits:**

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Vision insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid sick time
* Vacation Time

This role offers a unique opportunity to play a central part in warehouse operations, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and quality across daily workflows. By coordinating closely with management and team leads, the Warehouse Operations Coordinator helps maintain seamless processes and uphold the high standards that bellicon® customers expect.

Prior experience with/exposure to contracts is strongly desired  
*

Experience with video editing/understanding of time code and related concepts

jobs.title: Account Manager / Permit Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About National Permit Group**

National Permit Group is a full\-service permit and planning firm based in West Hollywood, CA, helping residential and commercial clients get their projects approved and permitted — primarily throughout Southern California, with additional projects in other states. We work with homeowners, developers, contractors, and property owners — and because we have an in\-house design team preparing architectural plans, we're able to offer clients a complete path from design through permit issuance.

Getting a project approved isn't just paperwork — it's a relationship business. Plans sit with city reviewers, questions come back, engineers need to weigh in, clients want to know what's actually happening. We're looking for someone who can own that relationship on all sides: the client who wants answers, and the city officials, plan checkers, and engineers who have them.

**About the Role**

We're hiring an **Account Manager / Permit Coordinator** to serve as the primary point of contact between our clients and everyone involved in getting their project permitted — city planning and building departments, plan checkers, permit techs, structural engineers, and contractors. This is not a data\-entry or paperwork\-routing role. It's a relationship and advocacy role: you're the person who knows the status of every project, knows who to call when something stalls, and knows how to ask the right question to get it moving.

What You'll Do

**Client Relationship Management**

* Serve as the main point of contact for residential homeowners and corporate clients (retail, restaurant, hospitality) throughout their project's permitting process
* Proactively communicate project status to clients with specifics — current stage, what's driving any delay, and the next concrete step — rather than a generic "still pending"
* Send plans to clients for review and approval, and manage their feedback
* Respond to client emails and calls promptly and knowledgeably

**City \& Agency Coordination**

* Communicate directly with city and county building/planning departments, plan checkers, permit techs, and officials
* Push each project forward by asking the right questions of reviewers and officials — identifying who's responsible, what's causing a delay, and when escalation is warranted — rather than passively waiting on a response
* Make submittals and pick up/drop off plans at city building and planning departments as needed
* Upload and download plans and corrections through city and agency portals
* Manage the issuance of permits once approvals are complete

**Project Coordination**

* Track every project's status in Trello, including when corrections come back and when plans are sent to the structural engineer
* Coordinate with our in\-house design team, structural engineers, and outside contractors to keep projects moving
* Flag risks or delays before they become client\-facing problems

**Administrative Support (light)**

* Keep project files and portal access organized
* Occasional coordination of ownership calendar/meetings related to client projects

**What We're Looking For**

*Required*

* Bachelor's degree
* Experience in a client\-facing coordination role — account management, client services, project coordination, or similar — ideally in construction, architecture, real estate development, or a related field
* Comfort being persistent and assertive with government offices and third parties on a client's behalf
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to explain technical/process status in plain language to clients
* Highly organized and able to track multiple projects at different stages simultaneously
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation (occasional travel to city offices and project sites)

*Preferred*

* Experience with permit processing, plan checking, or municipal approval processes
* Familiarity with Trello or similar project\-tracking tools
* Background or coursework in architecture, urban planning, or construction management
* Existing relationships with Southern California city planning/building departments

**What Makes You Successful**

* You take ownership of a project rather than waiting to be told what's next
* You're comfortable pushing back and escalating — professionally — when something isn't moving
* You can hold a lot of moving pieces in your head (or your Trello board) without dropping them
* You're as comfortable talking to a homeowner as you are to a plan checker
* You like being the person who actually knows what's going on

Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $70,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
Job Title: Clinical Research Coordinator II


Reports to: Research Regulatory/QC Manager


Location: Sherman Oaks and Travel within Greater Los Angeles, CA

  

Job Summary


The Clinical Research Coordinator II is a critical, high\-autonomy role that makes clinical research accessible to our patient population while providing administrative support to the clinic. Working on behalf of the Principal Investigator (PI), this individual independently manages the full study lifecycle—from feasibility and start\-up, through patient recruitment, eligibility assessment, and follow\-up, to the preparation and gathering of all data and documents for this highly regulated process. This role is best suited to a coordinator who has run trials with significant independence at a smaller or independent site, is comfortable owning multiple functions at once, and can train and mentor less experienced coordinators as our research program grows.

  

Major Duties \& Responsibilities


Research

* Works with PI to meet or exceed study enrollment as per Sponsor’s inclusion/exclusion criteria
* Complete feasibility questionnaires based on site information and all regulatory start up packages
* Recruits and enrolls patents in a friendly and professional manner, screening for eligibility criteria
* Conducts patient visit, collects all required data in appropriate formats, and follows up with all subjects as appropriate
* Reports, tracks and follows up on an all adverse events, protocol waivers, deviations and violations
* Complies with all study protocol, SOP and reporting requirements in a timely manner
* Responsible for completion of all required documentation with keen focus on the integrity of the data submitted by careful source document review, monitoring for missing data and/or inconsistencies.
* Maintains thorough and accurate records per regulatory/compliance standards at all times including but not limited to data for potential inspection; signed informed consents, source documentation, drug dispensing logs, subject logs, and all study related communication
* Creates study specific tools for source documentation when not provided by sponsor
* Collects, completes and enters data into study specific forms and/or electronic data capture system
* Appropriately handles and records all specimens; prepares specimens for shipment; tracks all shipments; tracks all inventory and calibrations.
* Attends relevant meetings (e.g. SIVs, PSSVs, IMVs, COVs, audits); assists Sponsor and FDA with any audits and responds to any monitoring/audit findings
* Actively communicate with stakeholders as appropriate (Sponsor, IRB, vendors) and maintain active communication on status of each study with PI and management as directed
* Trains, mentors, and provides day\-to\-day guidance to less experienced coordinators and clinic staff on research processes, GCP, and site systems; serves as a point of escalation for research\-related questions
* Independently owns day\-to\-day research operations for the site with minimal oversight, exercising sound judgment to prioritize competing study demands

  

Other

* Works in clinic to operate clinic cleanly, safely and efficiently
* Prepares exam and treatment rooms per cleaning protocols; assists with all processes (within scope of certification) to maintain inventory of supplies, medication, and equipment necessary for the operation of the clinic.
* Keys data into EMR/forms to maintain accurate office and patient records
* Organizes tasks to facilitate smooth work/patient flow
* Schedules and registers patients; referrals to specialists as appropriate
* Handles routine administrative tasks (filing, correspondence, mail) as needed to support clinic operations
* Adheres to all company policies and procedures, business conduct and work compliance standards
* Will be required to travel and work at multiple clinics within a reasonable driving distance from home clinic
* Any other task reasonably requested by company to meet its goals

  

Job Related Skills/Competencies

* Effective use of computerized patient care system
* Knowledge of medical terminology
* Knowledge of all safety requirements when handling biohazardous specimens or contaminated instruments
* Strong interpersonal skills to interact with patients, families, ancillary departments, physicians and co\-workers in a courteous and compassionate manner
* Strong, courteous and professional verbal skills to effectively convey sensitive information in a courteous manner in person or on the telephone; effective written communication and computer skills for proper charting
* Ability to work well under pressure and be quick on your feet
* Has a contagious and positive work ethic; models our core values
* An effective team player who contributes valuable ideas and feedback and can be counted on to meet commitments
* Proficient use of EMR and CTMS systems and ability to effectively use our systems within 2 weeks
* Demonstrated ability to train, mentor, and provide constructive feedback to less experienced coordinators
* Ability to independently manage multiple studies and competing priorities with sound judgment and minimal supervision, consistent with experience at a smaller or independent site
* Proficient use of Microsoft (e.g. Office, Excel, Word)

  

Education/Qualifications

* High school diploma required; Bachelor's degree in a health science or related field preferred
* Minimum of 2\-3 years of clinical research coordinator experience at an investigational site required, with solid knowledge of clinical trials terminology, processes, forms and reporting
* Experience at a smaller or independent site network, with broad ownership across regulatory, recruitment, data, and monitoring\-visit functions, strongly preferred
* Prior experience training, onboarding, or mentoring other coordinators preferred
* Certification (e.g. CCRC via ACRP or CCRP via SOCRA) a plus
* Phlebotomy certificate preferred

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.



Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video\-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**

Samsara is looking for a Sales Operations Manager to play a critical role in driving process optimization and transformation across our global sales organization. This role will partner with senior leaders across Samsara's go\-to\-market teams to design, build, and run critical sales capabilities — bringing together people, process, and technology to fundamentally improve how sellers engage with our internal systems and processes. This individual will have an outsized impact on the future of our sales organization by owning and executing complex, cross\-functional programs that enable Samsara to Build for the Long Term as we grow past $1BN in revenue.



The ideal candidate has experience driving transformative initiatives that span multiple teams and functions, and can translate ambiguous business problems into elegant, scalable solutions.


**This is a remote position open to candidates residing in the US** **except** **the San Francisco Bay Metro Area, NYC Metro Area, and Washington, D.C. Metro Area.**

* **You want to impact the industries that run our world**: Your efforts will result in real\-world impact — helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

* **You are a team player:** At Samsara, sales is a team sport. We help each other out by sharing best practices and focus on winning as a team.


**In this role, you will:**
* Partner with senior sales leadership and cross\-functional stakeholders to design, build, and optimize critical sales processes — from opportunity creation to close — including webstore, quoting, product, and approvals

jobs.description:
Social Media Manager

BFT West Hollywood **West Hollywood, CA 90046**

Part\-time **20–25 hours per week**  Primarily on\-site **$21–$25 per hour**

About the role

We’re looking for a creative, hands\-on Social Media Manager who can capture what makes BFT West Hollywood special and turn it into content that gets local people excited to try a class. We care more about real leads than likes or follower counts. This is an in\-studio role for someone who will take classes, get to know our coaches and members, and become part of the community.

**What you’ll do**

Plan, film and edit Reels, Stories, carousels, testimonials, class highlights, coach\-led content and promotions.

Keep a simple calendar and deliver a consistent weekly mix of finished content and reusable footage for both our feed and paid ads.

Develop lead\-focused posts and promotions that encourage people to book, tag a workout partner, share with a friend or claim an approved offer.

Capture a good mix of classes, members, coaches and events; write natural captions; and keep published details and offers accurate.

Conduct approved outbound Instagram DM outreach and invite suitable local prospects to try the studio.

Track which content and outreach generate leads, and keep all assets organized.

**Schedule and work location**

The position averages 20–25 hours per week and requires a mix of early mornings, evenings and occasional weekends. Most hours should be completed in the studio. Unless approved in advance, off\-site editing is capped at 5 hours per week. All hours must be recorded by date, location and task.

**You may be a great fit if**

You have a strong short\-form video portfolio showing content you personally filmed and edited.

You understand how social content can encourage someone to inquire or book—not just watch.

You are comfortable filming real people, giving simple on\-camera direction, and using Instagram, Canva and video\-editing tools.

You are creative, organized, dependable and genuinely interested in fitness and community.

**Compensation and growth**

$21–$25 per hour, depending on experience and portfolio quality.

$10 bonus for each eligible new prospect from your direct outbound Instagram DMs who attends their first class. Paid\-ad leads, inbound inquiries and existing leads are excluded.

Complimentary BFT membership, employee retail discount and 401(k), subject to eligibility requirements.

90\-day performance and compensation review, with opportunity for additional hours.

This position can grow into a full\-time role, paid\-ad management and eventually social media oversight for multiple BFT locations as our ownership group opens additional West LA studios. Added responsibilities and compensation would be agreed in advance.

**How to apply**

Send us your resume, portfolio or social links, availability, and examples of content you personally filmed and edited. Include a short note about why the role interests you and how you would create content that gets local people to book a class.

Pay: $21\.00 \- $25\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 20\.0 – 25\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Flexible schedule

This role is the frontline operator, providing field insights, performing routine audits, and coordinating restocks, recruiting and service actions across their assigned areas. Additionally, this role supports the project management of new **ROBO Shop** installations, relocations, and upgrades, ensuring all launch activities are executed on time and meet operational standards.


We follow an office policy with an expectation of five days per week working onsite. Being together in person helps us collaborate, stay connected, and build a strong team culture. * Recruiting individuals, teams, or 3rd party partners to operate ROBO Shop.
* Coordinate with restocking teams, vendors, and internal support.
* Perform field audits: inventory accuracy, cleanliness, visual merchandising compliance.
* Log visit notes, upload photos, and maintain accurate records.
* Conduct basic troubleshooting and escalate technical issues.
* Ensure product availability and uptime KPIs are met.
* Execute resets, seasonal updates, and product transitions.
* Support the end‑to‑end execution of new ROBO Shop installations, relocations, and upgrades.
* Coordinate with internal teams (Retail Store Operations, Supply Chain, Allocation, etc.) to ensure launch readiness.

* Document installation progress through photos, checklists, and launch status reports.
* Validate machine functionality and QC standards before handoff to Operations.
* Assist with vendor scheduling, access coordination, and on‑site troubleshooting during installs.
* Ensure all new ROBO Shop meet brand, merchandising, and performance standards pre\-launch.

* 4 therapy offices across 2 locations (plus subleases)
* \~20 clinicians
* 5 supervisors, including the practice founder, who leads workshops
* One virtual office manager (handles payroll and clinician onboarding part time)

Responsibilities

Client Intake

* Serve as the first point of contact for prospective clients (mainly via email)
* Track and follow up with prospective clients through the intake pipeline, with a focus on fast response times — we know prospective clients lose interest quickly if they don't hear back promptly
* Match clients to clinicians based on fit, specialty, and availability
* Schedule first consult calls
* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date records in our practice management system (e.g., Simple Practice)
* \[nice to have] Identify where prospects drop off and help tighten the process — including using AI tools to speed up response times, draft communications, and improve the workflow

Office Support (weekly, in\-person)

* Visit the Piedmont office once a week to ensure it's organized, stocked, and well cared for (including the plants)
* Flag maintenance or cleaning issues to the appropriate contact and coordinate with our cleaner as needed
* Orient new clinicians to the office space and handle key transfer

Workshop Support (6–8x/year, weekends)

* Support weekend workshops led by the practice founder with setup, breakdown, and food logistics
* Weekend dates provided months in advance

Ideal Candidate

* Warm, professional phone/email presence — comfortable being someone's first contact with therapy
* Organized and reliable; responsive within a consistent window, with urgency around new inquiries
* Proficient with technology\- especially tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Calendar, Sheets)
* \[nice to have] experience using Simple Practice \[this is an intuitive platform \& easy to learn]
* Curious about and comfortable using AI tools to work smarter and faster — interested in building small processes and automations, not just following instructions
* Detail\-oriented and process\-minded
* Comfortable working independently with minimal oversight
* \[Nice to have]: open to light client correspondence on weekends (under 1 hour) — a plus given how much response speed matters to conversion
* Experience working as an intake coordinator or with therapy practices a plus

Logistics

* \~10 hours/week, mostly remote. Ability to correspond with clients within 12\-24 hours key given how much response speed matters to conversion
* One in\-person office visit required weekly
* Workshop support 6–8x/year (weekend dates provided months in advance)
* Weekend responsiveness a plus, not required
* Reports to the Practice Director

Pay: $25\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 10\.0 – 15\.0 per week

* Are you able to come in person once a week to our office in Oakland?

* Do you have experience as an intake coordinator or working in a therapy practice?

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Oakland, CA 94605

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator - Cancer Center (Berkeley/Burlingame)
jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

***\*\*This position requires flexibility to work across various UCSF Medical Center locations, including UCSF Cancer Center in Berkeley and Burlingame.*** *\*\**

The Helen Diller Family Comprehensive Cancer Center (HDFCCC) Clinical Research Network Office is seeking a Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) to support the clinical research programs at our UCSF partner sites. The CRC will perform independently or with general direction at the fully operational journey level of the series to execute, manage, and coordinate research protocols, as directed by the Clinical Research Manager (CRM), Operations Manager, and/or Principal Investigator (PI); may coordinate the data collection and operations of several concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols, UCSF, and regulating agency policies.


Duties may include, but will not be limited to supporting the management and coordinating the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies, depending on their size and complexity; act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, clean, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports; coordinate staff work schedules, and assist the CRM and/or PI with oversight of other research staff; manage Investigator’s protocols in the Institutional Review Board online systems, as well as renewals and modifications of protocol applications and the implementation of new studies; participate in the review and writing of protocols to ensure institutional review board approval within University compliance; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; maintain all regulatory documents; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols; and perform other duties as assigned.


**Department Summary:**

The UCSF Helen Diller Family Comprehensive Cancer Center (HDFCCC) is one of only two cancer centers in the Bay Area to receive the prestigious designation of “comprehensive” from the National Cancer Institute (NCI).


The HDFCCC integrates the work of researchers and clinicians dedicated to four fundamental pursuits: laboratory research into the causes of cancer progression; clinical research to translate new knowledge into viable treatments; compassionate, state\-of\-the\-art patient care; and population research that can lead to improvements in prevention, early detection, and quality\-of\-life for those living with cancer. The twin pillars of precision medicine and precision population health guide research and treatment at HDFCCC.


  
Required Qualifications:


* High School Diploma; or equivalent experience
* Experience in clinical research or demonstrated research or training experience that translates into a clinical research setting
* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal skills; excellent, effective verbal and written communication skills to coordinate with subjects, team members, other departments, and outside institutions; and the ability to multitask in a fast\-paced environment while working with a diverse subject population
* Ability to work well independently, complete projects in a timely manner, and prioritize multiple projects to ensure the completion of essential tasks by deadlines
* Demonstrated knowledge and understanding of research, especially in the areas of biological sciences
* Experience with various computer program (Microsoft Office; internet\-based databases) and using specialized software such as OnCore
* Ability to sit and work at a computer for several hours per day; may need to travel between one or more campuses via UCSF shuttle; ability to stand for several hours of the day
* Working knowledge of federal, state, and local research; regulations and guidelines, and research practice methods in a laboratory or clinical setting
* Ability to apply relevant information to the assessment, required interpretation, and processing of medical data
Ability to independently interpret and apply policies, respond to requests, resolve issues, and provide assistance to faculty and staff at all levels in a team\-oriented environment  
* 

Preferred Qualifications:


* Fluency in the usage of IRB online system, iRIS, for submission, renewal, and modification of protocols through this system
* Understanding of patient population to create rapport and a relationship, while also giving insight to what is realistic and appropriate for patient participation
* Certification by the Society of Clinical Research Associates or the Association of Clinical Research Professionals
* Experience with electronic medical records
* Knowledge of location specific and departmental policies for dealing with reimbursement, guidelines for research, confidentiality and HIPPA regulations, following the UCSF mission statement and purpose for research, and a clear understanding of policies and procedures on patient safety and confidentiality (electronic and hard copy medical records, patient charts, communication, etc.); knowledge of medical terminology, research policies and guidelines, guidelines for packing/shipping infectious substances, database building/analysis, and data management within some of the following: Access, Stata, SASS/ SPSS, and Teleform programming platforms
* Ability to work with a sensitive population of patients (oncology patients)
* Prior analytical and writing skills in a science/research environment
* Knowledge of clinical research in oncology
* Knowledge and experience in managing oncology clinical trials
* Membership in a clinical research professional society
* Knowledge of medical terminology, research policies and guidelines, guidelines for packing / shipping infectious substance

jobs.description:
**About Broccoli**  



At Broccoli, we're building AI teammates for the people who build and maintain our world.


We partner with plumbing, HVAC, and electrical contractors, the hardworking businesses that keep homes and communities running, and replace fragmented software and repetitive manual work with AI that actually gets the job done.


Our AI teammates answer phones, book appointments, follow up with customers, recover missed revenue, and help contractors deliver exceptional customer experiences, all while integrating seamlessly with platforms like ServiceTitan.


Before we wrote a single line of code, we visited more than 140 contractors to understand how these businesses truly operate. That firsthand experience shaped everything we've built.


Today:

* Hundreds of contractors rely on Broccoli every day.
* We've grown to **$15M\+ ARR in under two years.**
* We're trusted by everyone from independent contractors to some of the largest private equity backed operators in the home services industry.
* We're backed by **Khosla Ventures** and **Y Combinator**.


We're still just getting started.  

  

**The Role**


Broccoli is looking for a People Operations Coordinator to serve as the right hand to our Director of People. This person will be the glue that holds our day\-to\-day people operations together — owning the details that make our employees feel taken care of, while also handling core HR administrative work. This is a great fit for someone who thrives on variety, loves being the go\-to person for questions, and wants to help build culture at a growing company.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own employee engagement and recognition programs — planning, coordinating, and executing initiatives that build culture and celebrate our team
* Lead the new hire onboarding experience end\-to\-end: preparing workspaces before day one, greeting new hires at the door, and making sure their first days feel welcoming and organized
* Manage new hire swag inventory and prep — ensuring swag is stocked, prepped ahead of new hire start dates, and sent out in time for arrival
* Help coordinate device and equipment setup for new employees, including ordering desks, monitors, and other workstation needs
* Own new hire checklist completion — tracking progress and following up directly with new hires on outstanding onboarding items
* Handle core HR administrative tasks, including sending offer letters and maintaining accurate employee records
* Run regular HR reports and pull data as needed to support the Director of People and leadership
* Serve as a point of contact for HR questions, escalating to the Director of People as needed
* Partner directly with the Director of People on ongoing HR projects and initiatives
* Act as a champion of in\-office culture — keeping our SF office running smoothly and looking for ways to make it a great place to work
* Support general HR administrative needs as they come up — this role is a true catchall for People Ops

**What We're Looking For**

* 1\-3 years of experience in HR/People Operations
* Highly organized with strong attention to detail — able to juggle multiple projects simultaneously
* A warm, welcoming presence — someone who genuinely enjoys being the face of the office and making people feel taken care of
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Familiar with Rippling as an HRIS system, and comfortable using AI tools to build workflows and improve processes
* A proactive, solutions\-oriented mindset — someone who spots what needs to get done and does it, rather than waiting to be asked
* Discretion and good judgment when handling sensitive employee information

*Broccoli is an equal opportunity employer and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local employment laws. We celebrate diverse perspectives and believe great teams are built by people with different backgrounds, experiences, and ideas.*


Compensation Range: $100K \- $120K

**About the Foundation**  

The James Irvine Foundation is a private, nonprofit grantmaking foundation dedicated to expanding opportunity for the people of California. The Foundation’s current focus is a California where all low\-income workers have the power to advance economically. Since 1937 the Foundation has provided more than $2\.92 billion in grants to organizations throughout California. The Foundation ended 2025 with $3\.6 billion in assets and provided $160\.2 million in grants. For more, please visit www.irvine.org.  

  

**About the Role \- Facilities \& Administrative Coordinator**  

The Facilities \& Administrative Coordinator will play a critical role in ensuring smooth day\-to\-day operations in our San Francisco office and provides administrative, clerical, and project‐related support to key operations and program areas. This role will be centrally positioned to learn about and influence all aspects of an impactful \& innovative foundation.  

  

You are someone who works well with a team and independently; have exemplary organizational skills with the ability to multi\-task and respond to rapidly changing priorities; and have superior interpersonal skills, high self\-awareness, and sound judgment.  

  

The Facilities \& Administrative Coordinator will have a high level of integrity, exceptional character, confidence, and the ability to remain calm in stressful situations. We are looking for a problem solver with excellent time management and prioritization skills, who is a passionate self\-motivator.  

  

**Your responsibilities will include:**  

Facilities Management* Supports staff with use of all office equipment and ensures that machines have adequate supplies. Serves as a central contact for troubleshooting and repair requests of all office equipment.
* Prepares and maintains files on all office equipment, appliances, furniture, and supplies, including all warranties and maintenance requirements.
* Coordinates and oversees all cleaning, repairs, and facility\-related services.
* Manages office supply orders and organizes storage closets.
* Assists the IT Department with on‐site troubleshooting and provides general support.
* Answers telephone calls and directs callers to individual staff members.
* Processes incoming and outgoing mail and faxes.
* Serves as liaison to the building management in the San Francisco office for day‐to‐day matters and provides office keys and access cards to staff as needed.
* Attends all safety and emergency training sessions offered by the building and informs staff and others using Foundation facilities about safety and emergency procedures. Manages the floor warden program and coordinates the activities of floor warden volunteers.
* Maintains kitchen, prepares coffee, orders, organizes, and stocks kitchen supplies.
* Coordinates with any caterers being brought in, including obtaining certificates of insurance and facilitating building access.


General Administration* Provides logistical support for medium/large group meetings onsite.
* For on‐site meetings, independently partner with other support staff (i.e., IT, Accounting, EAs, PAs, POs, etc.).
* Provides support to Program Associates and EAs during the planning, preparation, or managing of convenings onsite.
* Routinely attends Facilities and Administration team meetings and maintains a thorough working knowledge of the priorities for the operations and initiative areas of the Foundation.
* Maintains subscriptions to journals and other publications.
* Serves as the primary point of contact for external groups accessing the Foundation’s meeting space.
* Provides support with additional clerical and administrative tasks and projects as needed.

  

**Who you are:*** **A Team Player:** Nothing is beneath or above you. You are quick to always lend a hand, or two! You are able to earn influence without authority and naturally seek to support both small projects and large strategic goals.
* **Resourceful and Adaptable:** You're at ease with ambiguity and rapid change. You possess a positive attitude and identify creative solutions to obstacles. You can juggle many essential responsibilities at once, and you're rigorous about prioritizing.

jobs.title: Brand & Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**BRAND \& MARKETING COORDINATOR (Part\-Time to Full\-Time)**

Brucato Spirits · San Francisco, Mission District

20 hours/week minimum, full\-time preferred

We make amaro, gin, and liqueurs in a small distillery on South Van Ness, using California ingredients: heirloom apricots, house\-dried kumquats, botanicals from the state's fields and landscapes. We're a founder\-run company refocusing on the distillery itself — tours, events, new releases — and expanding distribution within California and . We're hiring one person to work directly with co\-founder Sierra Clark on all of our marketing and public\-facing work.

**ABOUT BRUCATO SPIRITS**

Brucato Spirits is a San Francisco craft distillery founded by Sierra and James Clark, who have formulated every recipe we've released. We're named for John Brucato, founder of San Francisco's first farmers market. Everything is distilled here, and most of our ingredients come from California farms and orchards. Our lineup includes four California amaros, Mission Gin, the Oro y Fierro kumquat liqueurs, and a series of small\-batch releases.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

This is a hands\-on, part\-time role supporting Sierra across brand, marketing, events, and sales. You'll be the person who keeps projects on schedule, turns ideas into finished work, and makes sure nothing gets dropped between a product launch, a photoshoot, a weekend tour, and next week's social media plan.

In your first year, you'll help launch new spirits, run a season of distillery events, contribute to how the brand looks and sounds, and build the systems that keep all of that organized. The role will grow with the company, and how it grows will depend partly on what you bring to it.

No two days will be the same.

**WHAT THE WORK IS ACTUALLY LIKE**

Much of this job is not glamorous. It's proofreading a label for the fourth time, tracking down a vendor who hasn't replied, moving boxes before a photoshoot, updating a spreadsheet, and rewriting a run\-of\-show the night before an event. The interesting parts — launches, shoots, events, learning production — only happen if the detailed work gets done first. We are looking for someone who takes that part seriously.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

● Support new spirits from concept to launch: packaging and label details, timelines, copy, launch materials, and the many small tasks involved in getting a release out.

● Manage social media and the website day to day with Sierra and our partners: content calendars, posting plans, scheduling, and website updates.

● Coordinate distillery events, from tours and tastings to launches and partner nights: planning, logistics, vendors, run\-of\-show, and working the event itself.

● Plan and oversee photoshoots: concept, shot lists, props, scheduling, and directing on set. This may include booking or hiring photographers, stylists, or assistants.

● Create sales and marketing materials (sell sheets, menus, signage, printed pieces, presentations) and manage outside designers or printers when needed.

● Industry and sales support: design and support partnerships, events, and creative activations.

● Contribute creative strategy: bring ideas and help develop campaigns and brand initiatives.

● Represent the brand at tastings, industry events, and with accounts as needed.

**INSIDE THE DISTILLERY**

This role is based at the distillery, alongside the people who make the spirits. You'll learn how production works, and if you're interested in bottling, blending, or distilling, there will be opportunities to participate.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

**Required**

● At least two years in a role where you were responsible for keeping projects, events, or content on schedule for someone else.

● Extremely organized and detail\-oriented. You keep lists, follow through, and catch mistakes before they go out.

● Creative, with a good eye and the ability to take a rough idea and produce something finished.

● Comfortable talking with the public on a tour, at an event, or behind a table.

● Self\-directed. You identify what needs doing and do it without waiting for instructions.

● Work well in a small team where priorities change and everyone covers more than one job.

● Able to work on\-site in San Francisco most weeks. Set on\-site hours will be decided together with the person we hire.

● 21 or older.

**Nice to have**

● Experience in spirits, wine, beer, hospitality, or food.

● Experience with social media management, photography or art direction, event production, and graphic design (Canva, Adobe Suite, or similar).

**DETAILS**

● Part\-time requires 20 hours per week, minimum. Full\-time option, with additional scope.

● Mostly on\-site at the distillery at set times, with some work from home.

● Occasional evenings or weekends for events.

● Compensation: Part\-time $30\-40/hr, or Full\-time salary of $60\-90K, plus benefits, depending on experience and scope of work.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Email sierra.clark@brucatospirits.com with "Brand \& Marketing Coordinator" in the subject line. Include:

1\. A short note about why you're interested in this role.

2\. A résumé.

3\. One example of something you organized or produced from start to finish — an event, a campaign, a shoot, a launch, a project. In a few sentences, tell us what went wrong along the way and how you handled it.

A portfolio, a social media account you've managed, or other examples of your work are welcome but not required.

Pay: $30\.00 \- $40\.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 20\.0 per week

Work Location: Hybrid remote in San Francisco, CA 94103

jobs.title: Account Manager - AI Natives
jobs.description:
Would you like to be a part of one of the most exciting companies in technology? NVIDIA, the world leader in Visual and Accelerated Computing, is seeking a Sales Account Manager with a proven track record in selling complex technology solutions to the startup ecosystem. This full\-time position requires close working relationships with NVIDIA solution architects and business development leaders to drive revenue for the company. If you have a passion for how technology is driving dynamic changes in exciting segments like Artificial Intelligence, Deep Learning, Cloud and Advanced Software Development, we'd like to talk with you.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Build relationships with frontier and neolab startups to strategically enable their growth.
* Work with startups that are model developers, build agentic harness platforms, codegen solutions, inference service providers, etc.
* Attain a minimum of 100% Quota attainment selling to AI Native Startups
* Maintain and submit accurate forecasts
* Qualify new opportunities, present NVIDIA solutions, overcome objections, negotiate and close business over the phone, MS TEAMS, Slack and in person
* Navigate and help lead highly cross collaborative and functional groups to drive objectives.
* Work closely with channel partners including Cloud Service Providers, Global System Integrators, Independent Software Vendors, OEMs, etc. to grow pipeline and close revenue.
* Have an understanding and clear delivery of NVIDIA value proposition, key features, product messages, and positioning.

**What we need to see:**

* This position requires regular work from our Santa Clara office
* 5\+ years of relevant technology sales experience with a minimum of 2 of those years interfacing with startup founders and developers, particularly in the adoption and integration of open\-source technologies.
* High technical acumen and ability to position NVIDIA CUDA\-X libraries to accelerate customer workloads, integrate libraries into partner platforms, navigate joint go\-to\-market opportunities and help startups scale.
* Understanding of startup investment process and support the drafting of both business and technical collaborations.
* Experience in go\-to\-market strategies and teaming with Technology Industry Channel Partners including Cloud Service Providers, Global System Integrators, Independent Software Vendors, OEMs, etc.
* Proven success in rolling up a forecast to sales leadership
* Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience)
* Salesforce.com experience is required

**Ways to stand out from the crowd:**

* Technical Account Manager experience with customers in the startup ecosystem
* Adept at balancing intense short\-term pressures with overall long\-term goals
* Educational degree related to technology, engineering, or AI/ML
* Excellent listening skills and ability to persuade \- using communication that convey concepts in a creative way
* A polished executive presence with a track record of successfully growing revenue for new innovative technology\-based solutions


NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most intelligent and hardworking people in the world working for us. If you're creative and autonomous, we want to hear from you!

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager, Bilingual (Spanish)
jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn't work together.  

  

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.  

  

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise\-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We're building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.



The Strategic Account Management organization is looking for a tenured, Spanish bilingual customer\-facing professional to manage relationships with some of Square's largest sellers and grow our Restaurant Strategic Accounts program. This program establishes, retains, and grows Square's most valuable and engaged single\-brand sellers.



You will work with business owners and c\-level executives to find creative ways for Square's first and third party ecosystem to solve their complex business needs across verticals and channels. You will enable sellers to grow with Square while serving as an upmarket seller advocate to product teams. Up to 50% of your book of business will be Spanish speaking.



The ideal candidate is a consistent over\-performer on all key performance metrics in their current role. They engage customers and influence internal stakeholders through excellent storytelling, organization, and persistence. They are comfortable leveraging technical frameworks for product solutions and are strongly tuned into commerce trends. They consistently identify "mutual win" opportunities, while navigating complex projects and negotiations. They are driven by serving customers, can work independently, and thrive in ambiguous environments.


*You will:*


* Manage a book of 175 Strategic Food \& Beverage Sellers
* Grow account\-based revenue via use\-case expansion opportunities, cross\-sell opportunities, and customized seller onboarding experiences
* Serve as the voice of the upmarket seller with Product Teams
* Act as a consultant and partner to high value restaurant sellers to accomplish their goals
* Identify opportunities for technical Square solutions to address existing customer needs; project manage the execution of these technical solutions in collaboration with cross\-functional teams
* Partner with Strategic Account Executives on high\-growth deals
* Negotiate pricing for use\-case expansion and retention of your sellers
* Provide white glove client service and troubleshooting to ensure resolution of seller issues
* Inform operations and program design for this segment at scale
* Conduct quarterly business reviews with various stakeholders


*You have:*


* 3\+ years of relevant Account Management experience
* Experience Managing, retaining and growing a book of business
* Comfortable working in Spanish
* Consistent over\-performance on key sales or customer success metrics
* Remarkable discovery skills with customers based in genuine curiosity about their business
* A technical solutioning framework, including the ability to conduct requirements gathering
* Proven experience managing multiple projects internally with engineering, product and finance teams
* Contract and/or pricing negotiations experience with external senior stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Creative and strategic problem solving capabilities, resolving issues and tackling opportunities with no playbook
* Restaurant experience and/or F\&B Technology experience preferred

jobs.description:
**About Vantage**
=================

  

Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well\-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

**Position Overview**

**This role is based in Phoenix, AZ or Santa Clara, CA in alignment with our flexible work policy. (3 days on site required, 2 days flexible).**

Customer Relationship Management:

Customer Communication \& Notifications:

* Oversee the execution of customer notifications, ensuring timely, accurate, and strategic communication.
* Manage customer requests via the Customer Portal, ensuring high\-quality, timely responses that enhance satisfaction.
* Maintain and audit customer distribution lists to ensure communication accuracy and effectiveness.


Project and Ticket Management:

* Oversee the lifecycle of customer access requests, ensuring a seamless and efficient experience.
* Lead the management of the Customer Experience ticket queue, ensuring timely resolution and service quality.
* Submit and track tickets on behalf of TAMs for various needs, including portal dashboard creation and enhancements.


Cross\-Functional Collaboration:

* Act as a senior liaison between departments to drive communication and collaboration, influencing organizational practices and priorities.
* Collaborate with the Real Estate team and other departments to ensure the CE team is aligned with project timelines and deployments.
* Partner with billing and accounting teams to oversee customer billing processes related to CE activities.

* Lead the development and refinement of documentation practices within the CE team to support high standards of service and internal communication.
* Oversee the preparation and review of Service Action Reviews (STAR), ensuring accuracy and completeness.

* Handle additional duties as assigned by Management.

* 5\-7 years of experience in one or more of the following areas: Data Center Operations, Project Management, Customer Support, or Sales.
* Experience in the Data Center Industry or Critical Operations is strongly preferred.

jobs.title: Account Manager, Automotive Vertical
jobs.description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. We aim to achieve this by cultivating a work environment where all team members belong and have the opportunity to thrive.



Lyft Business is changing the way companies, brands, and organizations alike leverage the Lyft platform to redefine the way they operate. We are solving big problems and meeting the needs of our clients and their people, from employees to customers and students to patients, in a whole new way. We are committed to always delivering best in class customer service. Our work is fun, challenging, and rewarding, and we are looking for a customer\-focused team member passionate about solving problems and delighting our customers.



As an Account Manager, Automotive on the Lyft Business team, you'll help Automotive Dealerships get more out of Lyft and its solutions after the sale. You'll join a talented team focused on one thing: using technology and Lyft's network of drivers to improve transportation for a company's customers and employees. We're looking for smart, ambitious individuals with account management experience who want to transform the way people move around and succeed in a fast moving environment.


**Responsibilities:**
---------------------


* Own a book of existing dealership accounts, with responsibility for retention, adoption, and revenue growth
* Build and manage an expansion pipeline within your accounts by developing trusted client relationships from first renewal conversation to signed expansion
* Accurately forecast, track, and manage revenue, renewals, and churn risk with multiple systems and tools (Salesforce, Claude, Gemini, Outreach, Google Suite, Mode, and Tableau)
* Achieve quarterly retention and net revenue growth targets
* Running quarterly business reviews, monitoring account usage and health data, and re\-engaging dormant users and rooftops
* Be the primary point of contact and build relationships with multiple decision makers across the dealership and dealer group
* Establish collaborative relationships with Lyft Business customers and demonstrate Lyft value to client\-focused initiatives
* Facilitate training, account review, customer engagement, and customer success criteria
* Liaise with internal stakeholders, including Operations, Support, and Product, to resolve client issues and drive the effectiveness of account initiatives
* Represent Lyft at marketing and trade show events
* Travel up to 20% of the time for meetings and visits to client locations
* Reports directly to the Manager of Automotive Sales

**Experience:**
---------------


* 2\+ years of B2B account management, customer success, or renewals experience carrying a retention or growth number (SaaS API integration, ad\-tech, or transportation a plus)
* Proficiency with Salesforce or similar CRM, AI tooling, and a knack for learning new sales tech
* A passion for mobility, the auto industry, or simply making transportation and logistics easy
* Experience owning the post\-sale lifecycle: onboarding, adoption, renewal, objection\-handling, and upsell
* Comfort using usage and performance data to identify risk and surface growth opportunities
* Demonstrated success in exceeding retention or growth targets
* Excellent communication skills \- A big part of the role is talking to clients on the phone and in\-person
* Possess a competitive spirit and are excited to prove not to others, but to yourself, what you are capable of
* High energy, you like to get things done and make things happen
* Self starter, loves to win, and grow professionally
* Ambitious and not afraid of putting yourself out there

**Benefits:**
-------------


* Great medical, dental, and vision insurance options with additional programs available when enrolled
* Mental health benefits
* Family building benefits
* Child care and pet benefits
* 401(k) plan with company match to help save for your future
* In addition to 12 observed holidays, salaried team members have discretionary paid time off, hourly team members have 15 days paid time off
* 18 weeks of paid parental leave. Biological, adoptive, and foster parents are all eligible
* Subsidized commuter benefits
* Monthly Lyft credits and complimentary Lyft Pink membership


*Lyft is an equal opportunity employer committed to an inclusive workplace that fosters belonging. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, age, genetic information, or any other basis prohibited by law. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories consistent with applicable federal, state and local law.*


*Lyft highly values having employees working in\-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. This role will be in\-office on a hybrid schedule — Team Members will be expected to work in the office 3 days per week on Mondays, Wednesdays, and Thursdays. Lyft considers working in the office at least 3 days per week to be an essential function of this hybrid role. Your recruiter can share more information about the various in\-office perks Lyft offers. Additionally, hybrid roles have the flexibility to work from anywhere for up to 4 weeks per year. \#Hybrid*


*The expected base pay range for this position in the San Francisco area is $23\.08\-$28\.85, not inclusive of potential equity offering, bonus or benefits. Salary ranges are dependent on a variety of factors, including qualifications, experience and geographic location. Your recruiter can share more information about the salary range specific to your working location and other factors during the hiring process.*

jobs.title: Enterprise account manager
jobs.description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and results\-driven Enterprise Account Manager to join our team and spearhead strategic relationships with our most valuable corporate clients. In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for enterprise clients, driving business growth through expert account management, innovative solutions, and proactive client engagement. Your energetic approach and strong negotiation skills will help expand our footprint within the enterprise sector, ensuring client satisfaction and long\-term loyalty. This position offers an exciting opportunity to work in a fast\-paced, technology\-driven environment where your leadership and sales expertise will make a significant impact.

**Duties**

* Develop and execute comprehensive account strategies to foster growth within assigned enterprise clients, identifying new business opportunities aligned with their needs.
* Manage and nurture existing client relationships through regular communication, personalized support, and tailored solutions to maximize client satisfaction.
* Lead negotiations for large\-scale deals, ensuring mutually beneficial agreements that meet both client objectives and company targets.
* Collaborate with marketing and product teams to craft compelling proposals, presentations, and demonstrations that showcase our software solutions’ value.
* Utilize CRM systems such as Salesforce to track sales activities, manage customer data, and generate detailed reports on account performance.
