jobs.title: Marketing and Communications Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Us**
At Ponte Vedra Plastic Surgery, we strive for excellence in the care we provide and in the results that we achieve. Offering numerous cosmetic and reconstructive surgeries, along with nonsurgical procedures at multiple locations, our outstanding surgeons and staff are able to provide superior results. Since we truly value each patient, we attend ongoing training to provide the most advanced procedures in our state\-of\-the\-art facilities. In addition, our main location features a fully licensed and accredited ambulatory surgery center. Our ultimate goal is to provide Northeast Florida with world\-class surgery in a safe and welcoming environment. We invite you to learn more about us.


To learn more about our practice, services, and patient care philosophy, we invite you to visit our website using the following link: https://www.pvps.com/

 **Position Summary**


We are seeking a **full time**motivated and skilled **Marketing and Communications Coordinator** to join our team. The Marketing \& Communications Coordinator is responsible for planning, coordinating, and executing marketing initiatives across all PVPS locations and service lines. This role supports patient acquisition, retention, brand awareness, provider promotion, events, social media, website management, email marketing, vendor relationships, and internal communications.

 **Key Responsibilities** *of this role include, but are not limited to*:

* **Campaign Planning \& Execution**


	+ Develop and manage monthly, quarterly, and annual marketing campaigns alongside Social Media and Marketing Coordinator.
	+ Coordinate promotions, events, and seasonal initiatives alongside Social Media and Marketing Coordinator.
* **Digital Marketing Channels**


	+ Maintain content found on the PVPS website. Adding new before and after photos, procedure pages, promotions and event information.
	+ Create promotional emails, event invitations, newsletters, provider spotlights, and other email campaigns through Constant Contact.
	+ Review digital ad performance and work with their creative team to develop ads for new promotions.
	+ Manage business profiles by responding to reviews and updating imagery or information.
* **Event Planning, Community Outreach \& Sponsorship Management**


	+ Plan and execute in\-office and community events.
	+ Coordinate vendors, sponsorships, catering, signage, and giveaways with the Social Media and Marketing Coordinator.
	+ Serve as the primary point of contact for community partnership and sponsorship opportunities.
	+ Evaluate requests and community involvement opportunities to ensure alignment with PVPS brand goals and budget.
* **Vendor \& Representative Relations**


	+ Manage relationships with industry representatives and vendors on behalf of PVPS.
	+ Find new co\-op marketing opportunities.
* **Budget, Reporting, \& Analytics**


	+ Track your marketing budget across all channels.
	+ Prepare reports for marketing, leadership, and board meetings.
	+ Review KPIs on a regular basis to track performance \- acknowledging wins, or areas of opportunity.

 **Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree and two years of relevant experience or an equivalent combination of education and appropriate experience.
* Demonstrated expertise in social media management and content creation.
* Demonstrated expertise in social media strategy and execution, particularly in high\-growth environments.
* Proven ability to leverage influencer partnerships and build online communities effectively.
* Creative thinker, constantly seeking new and innovative ways to engage audiences.
* Energetic, resilient, and passionate about driving growth in a fast\-paced sector.
* Multi\-site experience working with diverse brands.
 **What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation
* Comprehensive Health, Dental, and Vision plans
* 401(k) with Employer Contribution
* Paid Holidays and Vacation
* Voluntary Benefits

 **Why Join Us?**


Ascend Aesthetic Partners is a Management Services Organization (MSO) in the field of Plastic Surgery and Aesthetics. Founded on a commitment to excellence, innovation, and patient care, Ascend PSP brings together a network of highly accomplished plastic surgeons and their practices to advance aesthetic medicine, helping our patients feel more confident in their own bodies.


We are a group of plastic surgeons that have come together to collaborate on a whole new level. We believe that by learning from like\-minded plastic surgeons and collaborating, we can continually evolve and improve our practices, reaching more people and positively changing their lives.

jobs.title: Account Manager - Renewals (East)
jobs.description:
We are a global team of innovators and pioneers dedicated to shaping the future of observability. At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI\-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

**Your opportunity**

  


At New Relic, we believe in a virtuous cycle where **customer success fuels improved revenue performance**. Our Account Manager role is a pivotal function of an updated pod structure that sits at the intersection of Customer Success, Sales, and Product. Focused squarely on securing and growing our existing revenue base. We are a passionate, upbeat, and highly motivated group committed to exceptional customer loyalty, support, and expansion.



We are seeking an **Account Manager** to join our team and make a positive impact in the continued success and growth of our organization. In this critical role, you will be a driver of retention, adoption, and expansion. Strong leadership ensures positive relationships and alignment across Product, Marketing, and Sales, and Support. If you are passionate about building deep, strategic customer relationships and thrive in a quota\-carrying environment, let's talk!

  

**What you'll do**

  


You will utilize your skills in customer success, renewals, and sales methodologies to exceed customer expectations and deliver value across multiple key performance indicators.


**Drive Revenue \& Retention**


* **Pod Collaboration:** In partnership with the Account Team, you will function as **a secondary seller within a unified pod structure.** This role is essential in supporting the Account Executive (Core Seller) through seamless cross\-functional alignment and collaborative deal execution. You will review areas of opportunity (whitespace analysis), organize and manage enablement sessions with Technical Success Managers, and in partnership with the Solutions Consultants, help drive new growth opportunities for Account Executives.
* **Secure \& Negotiate Renewals:** Build positive relationships with customers including economic buyers, decision\-makers, champions and end\-users, negotiating contracts for direct and partner managed agreements.
* **Mitigate Churn:** Proactively identify accounts running "cold" and/or at risk (downgrades, churn, low BCM Burn Rate) and develop strategic plans to mitigate uncertainty, drive customer satisfaction, increase consumption, and maintain high renewal rates.
* **Deliver Expansion:** Grow revenue at renewal time and throughout the customer lifecycle. Increase Billable Consumption Metric (BCM) for current subscription customers and convert Pay\-As\-You\-Go (PAYG) customers through sub\-account prospecting and finding new upsell opportunities.


**Cultivate Customer Success \& Adoption**


* **Improve Customer Relationships:** Collaborate with Account Executives on accounts at key moments in the customer journey, becoming their voice within New Relic.
	+ Coordinate Customer Business Reviews
	+ Contribute to Account Plans
	+ Complete the Renewal Process \& Discussions
* **Increase Adoption:** Support customer Onboarding and strengthen product knowledge through:
	+ Account Health Checks
	+ Business Value Assessments Enablement Sessions
* **Advocate \& Resolve:** Collaborate with departments (Sales, Operations, Customer Solutions, Legal, and Collections) to resolve customer issues and advocate on their behalf.


**Strategic Execution \& Data Analysis**


* **Value Articulation:** Effectively communicate company messages and our value proposition, both verbally and in writing.
* **Data\-Driven Strategy:** Use strong analytical skills and experience working with data to professionally advise strategy, identify industry trends, and inform economic buyers and decision\-makers.
* **Operational Excellence:** Maintain an accurate customer master record, including buying programs, contract renewal dates, customer contact information, and sentiment. Ensure proper Salesforce hygiene with thorough, accurate, and up to date information for all your accounts, opportunities, and contacts.

  


**This role requires**

  

* **5\+ years of experience** in a quota\-carrying role, managing renewals, or customer success role, closing large complex time\-sensitive software contracts, preferably within the **SaaS industry**.
* Proven ability to **build deep, strategic relationships** with customer contacts at all levels of technical and non\-technical depth, including senior leadership and C\-Level Executives.
* Experience in building, analyzing, and interpreting **datasets** to accurately manage a pipeline for success.
* A track record of identifying key customer goals and steering value\-based discussions that lead to growth and expansion.
* Excellent professional written and verbal communication skills that actively demonstrates true relationship\-building, and the ability to work collaboratively with all internal and external points of contact effectively.
* Experience in mastering time management that yields retaining loyal customers and successfully renewing contracts **early** and **on time**.
* Experience using and learning new software (e.g., G Suite, **Salesforce,** Salesloft) MS Excel and PowerPoint presentations.


**Bonus points if you have**


* Thorough background in **Observability, Application Performance Monitoring,** and/or **DevOps**.
* Experience with **Consumption\-based Selling** and Platforms.
* Experience with multiple defined **Sales Methodologies** including, Challenger Sale, Command of the Message, and MEDDPICC.
* Contributed to building a scaled Customer Success function.
* Project Management Experience (e.g., PMP, CSM, or CSPO, certifications).

jobs.title: Sales Account Manager-Labels
jobs.description:
Job Description

**Job Code:** SOOS03

**Job Family:** Sales Representative: Sales Account Management

**Location: East Coast**

**Compensation: $120K \-$200K**

**Job Description**


The Heidelberg Sales Account Manager, Labels, is responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with existing and prospective customers within an assigned territory covering East Coast. This position specializes in the Gallus portfolio of label printing and converting solutions, including digital and flexographic label presses, workflow software, inspection systems, and related consumables.


As a consultative sales professional, the Sales Account Manager works closely with label converters, packaging printers, and brand\-focused manufacturing organizations to understand their production requirements, operational challenges, and growth objectives. By leveraging technical knowledge of label manufacturing processes and Heidelberg's label production technologies, the individual develops customized solutions that improve productivity, print quality, automation, and profitability.


The Sales Account Manager \- Labels serves as a trusted advisor throughout the equipment investment lifecycle, guiding customers through equipment evaluations, workflow assessments, ROI analysis, capital equipment purchasing decisions, installation planning, and long\-term partnership development. This role bridges the gap between technical production capabilities and customers' business goals, helping organizations remain competitive in the evolving label and packaging marketplace.

 **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Identify and qualify prospective label converters, packaging printers, commercial printers entering the label market, and other target customers within the assigned territory through networking, prospecting, industry research, trade shows, digital resources and working collaboratively with the Heidelberg/Gallus sales team.
* Develop and maintain strong, long\-term customer relationships by understanding label production workflows, business objectives, operational challenges, and future growth plans.
* Promote the Gallus portfolio of label solutions, including digital and flexographic label presses, workflow automation solutions, inspection technologies, and ancillary production equipment.
* Conduct comprehensive needs assessments and production evaluations to recommend equipment, software, and workflow solutions that improve operational efficiency and profitability.
* Serve as a trusted advisor by providing application expertise, market insights, and recommendations tailored to customer\-specific label and packaging production requirements.
* Develop and execute territory business plans and strategic account plans targeting key label converters and growth opportunities.
* Achieve or exceed annual sales objectives for label presses, equipment upgrades, software solutions, service agreements, and related product offerings.
* Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline utilizing Heidelberg's CRM platform and sales management processes.
* Prepare and deliver compelling presentations, equipment demonstrations, ROI analyses, and business proposals to executive, operational, and production stakeholders.
* Coordinate resources across sales, product management, applications, service, and executive leadership teams to support complex capital equipment sales opportunities.
* Act as the primary customer contact throughout the sales process, ensuring a seamless experience from prospecting through installation and post\-sale follow\-up.
* Conduct regular customer visits in accordance with territory coverage plans to maintain market visibility and identify new opportunities.
* Negotiate pricing, terms, and contracts in alignment with company policies and approved discount structures.
* Maintain current knowledge of industry trends, competitive technologies, market developments, and Heidelberg label solutions.
* Provide accurate forecasting, opportunity tracking, and pipeline reporting through Heidelberg's CRM and sales reporting systems.
* Represent Heidelberg at trade shows, customer events, industry conferences, and association meetings related to the label and packaging industry.

 **Qualifications and Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Printing Technology, Engineering, or related field preferred.
* Minimum 3\-5 years of business\-to\-business sales experience, preferably within the printing, label, packaging, converting, or capital equipment industries.
* Experience selling capital equipment, production technologies, workflow software, or manufacturing solutions preferred.
* Knowledge of label printing processes, digital printing technologies, flexographic printing, converting equipment, or packaging production is highly desirable.
* Ability to acquire and maintain detailed technical and application knowledge of Gallus label products and solutions.
* Strong consultative selling, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Demonstrated success in managing complex sales cycles involving multiple decision makers.
* Goal\-oriented and driven to consistently achieve sales targets and business objectives.
* Strong understanding and disciplined execution of the full sales process from prospecting through closing and post\-sale account management.
* Technical aptitude with the ability to discuss production requirements, equipment specifications, workflow efficiencies, and business outcomes with production managers and technical personnel.
* Strong verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.
* Professional demeanor with the ability to establish credibility and confidence with customers and stakeholders.
* Proficient with CRM systems, Microsoft Office Suite, and virtual presentation tools.
* Willingness to travel extensively throughout the assigned territory.

 **Key Competencies**

* Consultative Selling
* Territory Management
* Capital Equipment Sales
* Label and Packaging In

**Job title:** Digital Content Specialist

**Reports to:** VP, Business Process Transformation

**Department:** Merchant Solutions

**Location:** Alpharetta, GA

**Grade:** 16

 **About Priority:**  

Priority Commerce is a leading financial technology company on a mission to deliver a personalized, easy\-to\-adopt financial toolset that accelerates cash flow and optimizes working capital for businesses. Our vision is to eliminate the barriers to unlocking revenue \- empowering businesses to grow faster and operate smarter.  

We achieve this through the Priority Commerce Engine, an innovative platform that combines payables, acquiring, and banking and treasury solutions. This unified approach allows businesses to streamline financial operations, reduce unnecessary costs, and uncover new revenue opportunities.  

At Priority Commerce, we're driven by results. We expect our people to ***be known for results*** \- bringing expertise, momentum, and relentless focus to every challenge, helping our clients and each other thrive. **About the Role:**
The Digital Content Specialist owns the creation, organization, maintenance, and continuous improvement of digital content supporting Client Service and other Service Teams across the organization. The role serves as the primary administrator and content steward for Confluence and supports the implementation and expansion of Atlassian Rovo, using AI\-powered search and knowledge capabilities to help Service representatives access accurate information in real time. The Digital Content Specialist partners with Client Service, Product, Technology, Operations, and other business teams to identify knowledge gaps, improve content quality, establish content governance, and expand Confluence and Rovo across Service Teams.

 **Responsibilities:**

**Digital Content \& Confluence Management**

* Own the day\-to\-day management and administration of digital content within Confluence.
* Create, organize, publish, and maintain knowledge articles, procedures, FAQs, troubleshooting guides, and other service documentation.
* Establish and maintain a consistent content structure, taxonomy, navigation, and standards across Confluence spaces.
* Regularly review content for accuracy, relevance, completeness, and usability.
* Identify outdated, duplicate, or missing content and coordinate updates with appropriate subject matter experts.
* Develop and maintain content governance, including ownership, review cycles, version control, and publishing standards.
* Translate complex technical and operational information into clear, actionable content for Service Teams.
* Monitor content usage and identify opportunities to improve the employee experience.

**Rovo \& AI Enablement**

* Support the implementation and ongoing optimization of Atlassian Rovo within Client Service.
* Develop and maintain the knowledge foundation required for Rovo to provide accurate and useful responses.
* Partner with Client Service leadership and Technology teams to identify high\-value use cases for AI\-assisted knowledge retrieval.
* Test and evaluate Rovo responses to identify content gaps, inaccuracies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Establish processes for monitoring and continuously improving AI\-generated results.
* Help define appropriate governance, permissions, and content\-access practices to protect proprietary and sensitive information.
* Train and support Service Teams in effectively using Rovo as part of their daily workflows.
* Expand the use of Confluence and Rovo from Client Service to additional Service Teams across the organization.

**Service Team Enablement**

* Work directly with Service Team leaders and subject matter experts to understand their information and knowledge needs.
* Build and maintain content that enables representatives to quickly resolve client questions and issues.
* Support the development of a centralized and scalable knowledge\-management strategy.
* Identify recurring questions, production issues, process gaps, and other opportunities for new or improved content.
* Partner with teams to convert tribal knowledge and undocumented processes into accessible digital content.
* Support onboarding and ongoing training by ensuring Service Teams have current and reliable knowledge resources.

**Continuous Improvement \& Analytics**

* Establish metrics to measure content quality, adoption, search effectiveness, and Rovo utilization.
* Analyze search and usage trends to identify knowledge gaps and opportunities for improvement.
* Use feedback from Service Teams to continuously improve content and the overall knowledge experience.
* Identify opportunities to automate content\-management and reporting processes.
* Stay current on developments in AI\-powered knowledge management, Confluence, Rovo, and related technologies.

 **What Success Looks Like:**
This role helps transform Confluence from a static documentation repository into a centralized, continuously improving knowledge platform, while leveraging Rovo to make that knowledge available to Service Teams in real time.

Cornerstone Building Brands is a leading manufacturer of exterior building products for residential and low\-rise non\-residential buildings in North America. Corporate stewardship and Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG) responsibility are embedded in our culture. jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist
jobs.description:
**Napa Home \& Garden, a dynamic home décor wholesaler, with its headquarters in Norcross, GA is searching for a driven, energetic team player to join our growing team. We provide sophisticated products for the home, selling to style\-conscious retailers via a best\-in\-class shopping experience. Napa is well\-recognized within the home décor industry and is one in a family of highly regarded brands.**

**Job Purpose**


The Digital Marketing Specialist owns website performance marketing for our newest sales channel DTC and our legacy B2B sites, along with the other digital assets that support them. This is a hands\-on execution role reporting to the Senior Director of Business Development. Your focus splits roughly 80/20 between DTC and B2B support. The Senior Director sets content strategy and campaign calendars. You will own day\-to\-day execution across site merchandising, conversion optimization, SEO, site analytics, content, and our other digital assets, partnering with Design, IT, and Sales to get work live. Strategy and the campaign calendar sit with the Senior Director; your input on what's working is expected, and the role can grow into strategic ownership as you build a track record. You'll help keep our Shopify storefront fresh, contribute content ideas, and use AI tools to move fast without losing the friendly design\-forward voice that defines our brand.


**Duties and responsibilities**

  

* Own the execution of website performance marketing for DTC and B2B, plus the campaigns and content that run across the website and other digital assets.
	+ Collaborate with Design to build, schedule, and launch campaign assets across the website and our other digital assets, from brief to live.
	+ Adapt messaging and creative for DTC and B2B audiences.
	+ Analyze campaign and site performance against the calendar set by the Senior Director, flagging timing conflicts early and recommending initiatives to optimize execution and improve performance.
* Own website performance end to end: day\-to\-day operation of the Shopify storefront, including updates, merchandising, promotions, conversion optimization, and technical integrations like metafields and app setups.
	+ Schedule and Publish daily/weekly site updates (product launches, copy changes, navigation, and landing pages)
	+ Merchandise collections and homepage placements to feature seasonal and best\-selling product.
	+ Build and schedule promotions, bundles, discount codes, and sale mechanics end to end.
	+ Configure metafields, theme sections, and app integrations, with support from IT and freelancers on anything custom.
	+ Monitor site health (broken links, page speed, checkout errors) and resolve or escalate quickly.
	+ Run on\-site conversion testing (product page layout, imagery, copy, promo placement) using Lucky Orange and Shopify data, and implement the winning variant.
	+ Maintain a continuous testing roadmap — hypothesis, test, result, next step — with a running log of what shipped and what it moved.
	+ Own site analytics in GA4: event and conversion tracking, funnel and landing\-page reporting, and channel attribution across all traffic sources.
	+ Diagnose conversion drop\-off by device, template, and traffic source, and turn findings into a prioritized queue of site fixes.
* Drive organic and paid traffic growth to the site, and measure its impact on sessions, conversion rate, and revenue.
	+ Implement SEO and AEO best practices across product, collection, and landing pages, aligned to the strategy set by the Senior Director.
	+ Support paid media campaigns as budgets are established.
	+ Track rankings, organic traffic, and content velocity in SEMrush, Google Search Console, and GA4\.
* Support B2B marketing initiatives under the direction of the VP of Marketing and Sales.
* Track and report on performance to inform strategy.
	+ Pull weekly metrics from Shopify, Klaviyo, Sprout Social, GA4, and Lucky Orange.
	+ Provide regular performance reports to your manager, with observations and suggested next steps where you see them.
* Utilize AI tools such as Jasper, Claude, and Shopify Magic to streamline content creation.
* Collaborate with internal teams (IT, creative, sales) and external partners on projects and integrations.


**Skills and Qualificiations**


* Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 3\-5 years in digital marketing (ecommerce site management, performance marketing, or content), including hands\-on ownership of website performance and campaign execution.
* Solid copywriting skills for the website and other digital assets, with writing samples to share.
* Demonstrated hands\-on Shopify experience (merchandising, navigation, landing pages, promotions and discount mechanics).
* Working SEO/AEO knowledge applied to live ecommerce pages, with interest in growing into more strategic work.
* Hands\-on GA4 experience — conversion and event tracking, funnel and landing\-page reporting, and channel attribution.
* Comfort designing and reading structured A/B tests on live pages, and acting on the result.
* Comfortable using AI tools for content creation.
* A strong design sense and appreciation for design\-led brands.
* Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* Curious, self\-motivated, and comfortable in a fast\-moving environment.
* Highly organized and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Exposure to both DTC and B2B content for a consumer brand.
* Background in home décor, furniture, interiors, gifting, or consumer goods.
* Familiarity with Shopify app ecosystems and theme customization.


**What Success Looks Like**



You'll be measured on:


* Site conversion rate and revenue per session
* Click\-through rate (CTR) and campaign performance
* Testing velocity and win rate on site experiments
* Organic traffic growth and content production velocity
* Engagement and audience growth across other digital assets

What We're Looking For

· Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.

· Strong organizational and time management abilities.

· Ability to remain calm under pressure and make sound decisions.

Why AF Services?

jobs.title: Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**Requisition ID:** 73076

**About Whirlpool Corporation**

  

Whirlpool Corporation (NYSE: WHR) is a leading home appliance company, in constant  

pursuit of improving life at home. As the only major U.S.\-based manufacturer of kitchen  

and laundry appliances, the company is driving meaningful innovation to meet the evolving  

needs of consumers through its iconic brand portfolio, including Whirlpool, KitchenAid,  

JennAir, Maytag, Amana, Brastemp, Consul, and InSinkErator. In 2025, the company reported  

approximately $16 billion in annual net sales \- close to 90% of which were in the Americas \-  

41,000 employees, and 35 manufacturing and technology research centers. Additional  

information about the company can be found at WhirlpoolCorp.com.

**This role in summary**
------------------------

  

Whirlpool is currently seeking qualified candidates for a Social Manager, Brand Communications. This is an onsite role at our World of Whirlpool Office located in Chicago.

  

As part of the Social Media team at Whirlpool, this role is responsible for leading the strategy and execution for best in class social across our portfolio of brands. Coordinating with media, creative and brand counterparts, you will be responsible for ensuring we’re continuing to reach AND engage with our consumers across multiple social platforms.

  

The Social team is part of the Brand Organization*.* The team is comprised of social, content creation and influencer expertise to ensure we’re moving at the speed of social and bringing our brands to the forefront of culture. All members of the team provide expertise and support to both our brand leads, while also collaborating directly with our in\-house agency, WoW studios and bringing a social first approach to our campaigns. The position reports to the Senior Manager, Social and Influencer

**Your responsibilities will include**
--------------------------------------

* Leads the social strategy and execution end to end
* Owns/plans content calendars for always on \+ Influencer content
* Lead the daily community management, to maintain an active and responsive community, to drive more positive interactions \- while also infusing engagement full circle to new briefs.
* Collaborates with our influencer lead to expand reach and credibility within social communities.
* Partner with Strategy, Insights, Analytics, Comms and Media teams to ensure that all work is grounded in community understanding, data and insights
* Keeps abreast of the latest social media trends and best practices and shares out with broader organizations.
* Maintain a high level of quality assurance while holding the team accountable for delivering social first campaigns
* Be a cross\-functional teammate who engages, listens and collaborates with internal teams on Whirlpool’s overall marketing strategy.
* Be an inspiring peer and help develop out of the box and first\-to\-market experiences, activations, and content that will drive social conversations and increase brand love.
* Analyze key performance metrics regularly, making vital recommendations for improvement.
* Lead in social trafficking of assets for paid initiatives, while also having experience boosting always on content directly
**Minimum requirements**
------------------------

* Bachelor’s degree
* 7\+ years of experience in Social Media or Social Strategy
* 5\+ years of experience with multi\-channel communications planning, using data to identify insights and build strategies for social content
* 5\+ years of experience across all social platforms, including but not limited to: Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, Snapchat, YouTube and LinkedIn
**Preferred skills and experiences**
------------------------------------

* A motivated social manager ready to take ownership of projects, present to teams, and eventually mentor and grow junior talent
* A passion for social, including a natural curiosity for trendspotting and identifying new channel opportunities.
* High comfort level with data and the ability to monitor, analyze, and interpret social media metrics and transform those insights into new opportunities
* Comprehensive and deep understanding of social platforms and the role they play within the broader strategy team
* Driven by a passion for evolving technologies
**What we offer**
-----------------

  

Generous benefits package, Whirlpool employee discount, fitness \& educational reimbursement programs, kitchenettes, and more! Saint Joseph/Benton Harbor locations: Beautiful, recently renovated office space, free coffee, biking/walking trails, and access to The Eddy \- Early Childhood Center (depending upon availability \- additional costs required).

Whirlpool’s Ways of Working


Our goal is to provide an environment that helps you bring your best to Whirlpool every day. We offer flexibility and industry\-leading time\-off benefits that will help you balance what’s important at work and at home, including:

* **Always On Flexibility** \- You will have the autonomy to manage personal, family, and outside\-of\-work commitments as needed.
* **Two\-Week Work from Anywhere** \- Minimum of one\-week increments for a total of two weeks per year.

**Company:** Life Time Car Wash  
**Location:** Chicago, Illinois  
**Job Type:** Full\-time  
**Work Location:** On the road / Field\-based

About the Role

Life Time Car Wash is looking for a confident, persuasive, and results\-driven **Field Sales Representative** to help expand our car wash partnership network across the Chicago area.

This is not a desk\-only sales position.

You will visit car wash owners and decision\-makers in person, introduce our Life Time Car Wash partnership program, present the business opportunity, build relationships, follow up with prospects, and help turn qualified locations into long\-term partners.

We are looking for someone who knows how to communicate professionally, handle objections, negotiate, and close deals.

What You’ll Do

* Visit car washes throughout Chicago and surrounding areas
* Speak directly with owners, managers, and other decision\-makers
* Present and explain the Life Time Car Wash partnership program
* Identify each car wash’s capacity, services, pricing, and operational needs
* Schedule and conduct sales presentations and meetings
* Build strong relationships with potential partners
* Follow up with interested car wash owners by phone, email, and in person
* Handle questions and objections professionally
* Negotiate partnership terms within company guidelines
* Move qualified prospects toward signed agreements
* Maintain organized records of visits, conversations, follow\-ups, and deal progress
* Provide regular updates on leads and closed partnerships
* Represent Life Time Car Wash professionally in the field

Who We’re Looking For

The ideal candidate is:

* Confident speaking face\-to\-face with business owners
* Comfortable walking into businesses and starting conversations
* Strong at sales, persuasion, negotiation, and relationship building
* Professional, energetic, and self\-motivated
* Comfortable working independently in the field
* Organized with follow\-ups and lead management
* Able to explain a business opportunity clearly and simply
* Persistent without being aggressive
* Focused on results and closing deals

Previous experience in **B2B sales, field sales, automotive sales, dealership sales, car wash sales, merchant services, business development, or account management** is preferred.

Compensation \& Benefits

* Base salary
* Commission for successful sales/partnerships
* Performance\-based earning opportunities
* Company vehicle or transportation support
* Opportunity to grow with an expanding business
* Direct involvement in developing the Chicago partner network

Schedule

Full\-time position with field visits primarily during normal business hours.

Some flexibility may be required depending on meetings with business owners.

What Success Looks Like

You don’t just collect business cards.

You identify qualified car wash locations, get in front of the decision\-maker, clearly communicate the opportunity, follow up consistently, and help bring new car wash partners into the Life Time Car Wash network.

Apply

Send your resume along with a short introduction explaining:

**Why are you confident you can walk into a car wash, speak directly with the owner, and convince them to take a meeting with us?**

Client Intake

Workshop Support (6–8x/year, weekends)

* Support weekend workshops led by the practice founder with setup, breakdown, and food logistics
* Weekend dates provided months in advance

Ideal Candidate

* Warm, professional phone/email presence — comfortable being someone's first contact with therapy
* Organized and reliable; responsive within a consistent window, with urgency around new inquiries
* Proficient with technology\- especially tools like Google Workspace (Docs, Calendar, Sheets)

* Curious about and comfortable using AI tools to work smarter and faster — interested in building small processes and automations, not just following instructions

* Comfortable working independently with minimal oversight
* \[Nice to have]: open to light client correspondence on weekends (under 1 hour) — a plus given how much response speed matters to conversion
* Experience working as an intake coordinator or with therapy practices a plus

Logistics

* \~10 hours/week, mostly remote. Ability to correspond with clients within 12\-24 hours key given how much response speed matters to conversion
* One in\-person office visit required weekly
* Workshop support 6–8x/year (weekend dates provided months in advance)

* Reports to the Practice Director

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Oakland, CA 94605

**BRAND \& MARKETING COORDINATOR (Part\-Time to Full\-Time)**

Brucato Spirits · San Francisco, Mission District

20 hours/week minimum, full\-time preferred

We make amaro, gin, and liqueurs in a small distillery on South Van Ness, using California ingredients: heirloom apricots, house\-dried kumquats, botanicals from the state's fields and landscapes. We're a founder\-run company refocusing on the distillery itself — tours, events, new releases — and expanding distribution within California and . We're hiring one person to work directly with co\-founder Sierra Clark on all of our marketing and public\-facing work.

**ABOUT BRUCATO SPIRITS**

Brucato Spirits is a San Francisco craft distillery founded by Sierra and James Clark, who have formulated every recipe we've released. We're named for John Brucato, founder of San Francisco's first farmers market. Everything is distilled here, and most of our ingredients come from California farms and orchards. Our lineup includes four California amaros, Mission Gin, the Oro y Fierro kumquat liqueurs, and a series of small\-batch releases.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

This is a hands\-on, part\-time role supporting Sierra across brand, marketing, events, and sales. You'll be the person who keeps projects on schedule, turns ideas into finished work, and makes sure nothing gets dropped between a product launch, a photoshoot, a weekend tour, and next week's social media plan.

In your first year, you'll help launch new spirits, run a season of distillery events, contribute to how the brand looks and sounds, and build the systems that keep all of that organized. The role will grow with the company, and how it grows will depend partly on what you bring to it.

No two days will be the same.

**WHAT THE WORK IS ACTUALLY LIKE**

Much of this job is not glamorous. It's proofreading a label for the fourth time, tracking down a vendor who hasn't replied, moving boxes before a photoshoot, updating a spreadsheet, and rewriting a run\-of\-show the night before an event. The interesting parts — launches, shoots, events, learning production — only happen if the detailed work gets done first. We are looking for someone who takes that part seriously.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

● Support new spirits from concept to launch: packaging and label details, timelines, copy, launch materials, and the many small tasks involved in getting a release out.

● Manage social media and the website day to day with Sierra and our partners: content calendars, posting plans, scheduling, and website updates.

● Coordinate distillery events, from tours and tastings to launches and partner nights: planning, logistics, vendors, run\-of\-show, and working the event itself.

● Plan and oversee photoshoots: concept, shot lists, props, scheduling, and directing on set. This may include booking or hiring photographers, stylists, or assistants.

● Create sales and marketing materials (sell sheets, menus, signage, printed pieces, presentations) and manage outside designers or printers when needed.

● Industry and sales support: design and support partnerships, events, and creative activations.

● Contribute creative strategy: bring ideas and help develop campaigns and brand initiatives.

● Represent the brand at tastings, industry events, and with accounts as needed.

**INSIDE THE DISTILLERY**

This role is based at the distillery, alongside the people who make the spirits. You'll learn how production works, and if you're interested in bottling, blending, or distilling, there will be opportunities to participate.

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

**Required**

● At least two years in a role where you were responsible for keeping projects, events, or content on schedule for someone else.

● Extremely organized and detail\-oriented. You keep lists, follow through, and catch mistakes before they go out.

● Creative, with a good eye and the ability to take a rough idea and produce something finished.

● Comfortable talking with the public on a tour, at an event, or behind a table.

● Self\-directed. You identify what needs doing and do it without waiting for instructions.

● Work well in a small team where priorities change and everyone covers more than one job.

● Able to work on\-site in San Francisco most weeks. Set on\-site hours will be decided together with the person we hire.

● 21 or older.

**Nice to have**

● Experience in spirits, wine, beer, hospitality, or food.

● Experience with social media management, photography or art direction, event production, and graphic design (Canva, Adobe Suite, or similar).

new_jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager, Bilingual (Spanish)
new_jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn't work together.  

  

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we've embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.  

  

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise\-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We're building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.



The Strategic Account Management organization is looking for a tenured, Spanish bilingual customer\-facing professional to manage relationships with some of Square's largest sellers and grow our Restaurant Strategic Accounts program. This program establishes, retains, and grows Square's most valuable and engaged single\-brand sellers.



You will work with business owners and c\-level executives to find creative ways for Square's first and third party ecosystem to solve their complex business needs across verticals and channels. You will enable sellers to grow with Square while serving as an upmarket seller advocate to product teams. Up to 50% of your book of business will be Spanish speaking.



The ideal candidate is a consistent over\-performer on all key performance metrics in their current role. They engage customers and influence internal stakeholders through excellent storytelling, organization, and persistence. They are comfortable leveraging technical frameworks for product solutions and are strongly tuned into commerce trends. They consistently identify "mutual win" opportunities, while navigating complex projects and negotiations. They are driven by serving customers, can work independently, and thrive in ambiguous environments.


*You will:*


* Manage a book of 175 Strategic Food \& Beverage Sellers
* Grow account\-based revenue via use\-case expansion opportunities, cross\-sell opportunities, and customized seller onboarding experiences
* Serve as the voice of the upmarket seller with Product Teams
* Act as a consultant and partner to high value restaurant sellers to accomplish their goals
* Identify opportunities for technical Square solutions to address existing customer needs; project manage the execution of these technical solutions in collaboration with cross\-functional teams
* Partner with Strategic Account Executives on high\-growth deals
* Negotiate pricing for use\-case expansion and retention of your sellers
* Provide white glove client service and troubleshooting to ensure resolution of seller issues
* Inform operations and program design for this segment at scale
* Conduct quarterly business reviews with various stakeholders


*You have:*


* 3\+ years of relevant Account Management experience
* Experience Managing, retaining and growing a book of business
* Comfortable working in Spanish
* Consistent over\-performance on key sales or customer success metrics
* Remarkable discovery skills with customers based in genuine curiosity about their business
* A technical solutioning framework, including the ability to conduct requirements gathering
* Proven experience managing multiple projects internally with engineering, product and finance teams
* Contract and/or pricing negotiations experience with external senior stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Creative and strategic problem solving capabilities, resolving issues and tackling opportunities with no playbook
* Restaurant experience and/or F\&B Technology experience preferred

**Sales Account Manager**


**Pay from $80,000 to $110,000 per year**


Uline, a name millions of businesses across North America know and trust, is looking for an experienced Sales Account Manager to build our growing South San Francisco, California market.


Your role on our Sales team is to help businesses from every industry discover quality products with speed and service you’ll be proud to deliver.

new_jobs.description:
Overview:

Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our \~16,800 employees create world\-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Learn more about what we do.  

Our award\-winning culture embraces a bold vision of where technology can take us and a passion for tackling challenging problems with industry\-first solutions. We believe that when people feel a sense of belonging, they can be more creative, innovative, and thrive at all points in their careers.  

Keysight’s Global Services organization is seeking an **Expert\-Level Services Account Manager** to drive strategic growth, expand multi\-year service contracts, and deepen account penetration across enterprise, semiconductor, aerospace \& defense, and communications customers in the Northeast region.
This senior individual contributor will own large, complex service portfolios—Calibration, Repair, Asset Management, Uptime Services, Managed Services, and Digital/Software Support—acting as the primary business leader for post‑sales lifecycle value.
You will be responsible for developing account strategy, shaping long\-term customer roadmaps, and aligning Keysight’s advanced service capabilities with customer operational, engineering, and mission‑critical requirements.
Responsibilities:
**Strategic Account Leadership*** Own and grow an assigned portfolio of high\-value enterprise and A\&D accounts throughout the Northeast region.
* Develop multi\-year **Lifecycle Services** strategies tied to customer technology roadmaps and test modernization initiatives.
* Serve as the trusted advisor on test asset strategy, uptime optimization, calibration programs, and operational risk reduction.
* Lead executive\-level service reviews, QBRs, and long\-term service planning discussions.

**Sales Growth \& Business Development*** Drive YoY growth across all Keysight service offerings, consistently delivering against quota and profitability targets.
* Identify whitespace within accounts and introduce advanced solutions including **KeysightCare, Repair \& Calibration Services, Asset Optimization, Test Ops, Managed Services, and Test Automation software services**.
* Build multi\-year contracts leveraging Keysight’s regional service centers and onsite managed service capabilities.
* Negotiate commercial terms, pricing, and service deliverables at expert level.

**Customer Relationship Management*** Own C‑suite, VP\-level, and Director\-level service relationships to ensure customer satisfaction and long\-term retention.
* Engage deeply with engineering, metrology, operations, production, and program teams to understand mission requirements.
* Serve as escalation point for critical service events, outage mitigation, or urgent operational support.

**Cross\-Functional Leadership*** Partner with Field Sales, Services Delivery, Service Centers, Technical Support, and Solutions Consulting to execute customer strategy.
* Collaborate with Legal, Finance, and Operations to structure complex service agreements.
* Lead internal teams during RFPs, contract renewals, and technical solution development.


Qualifications: **Required*** 8–12\+ years in technical account management, services sales, or lifecycle services roles (preferably in test \& measurement, A\&D, semiconductor, telecom, or electronics industries).
* Deep understanding of electronic test equipment, calibration and repair processes, and asset lifecycle management.
* Proven ability to manage complex enterprise customers and close multi\-year service agreements.
* Strong business acumen in negotiation, commercial structuring, and value\-based selling.
* Ability to confidently lead customer executive reviews, service strategy sessions, and program readiness meetings.

**Preferred*** Experience working with enterprise customers in the Northeast corridor—Aerospace \& Defense, semiconductor fabs, network equipment providers, or R\&D labs.
* Understanding of government contracting (DoD, FFRDC, prime/sub relationships) and ITAR/DFARS considerations.
* Familiarity with KeysightCare, TestOps, NPI support structures, and lab modernization programs.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or related field; MBA or technical graduate degree is a plus.

**Core Competencies*** Strategic account planning and executive communication
* Expert\-level negotiation and commercial strategy
* Technical credibility across test engineering and service operations
* Relationship building at all levels
* Problem\-solving and escalation management
* Resource coordination across cross\-functional teams
* Long\-cycle and complex\-deal sales execution

**Success Indicators*** Annual growth of service contract value and penetration rate
* High customer satisfaction and strong renewal performance
* Increased multi\-year service agreements and expanded KeysightCare adoption
* Strong alignment with Sales and Delivery teams to improve customer outcomes
* Development of long\-term, strategic service roadmaps with top regional accounts

  

Pay Range:  

USD $225,190\.00 \- USD $375,320\.00 Year

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?


At Molecular Devices, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.


You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.


Join Molecular Devices and help drive scientific discovery for life science customers in academia, biotech, pharma, and government. Our automated and AI\-enabled technology empowers researchers to tackle complex questions and gain deep insights, accelerating the development of safer, more effective therapeutics. As part of our team—rooted in collaboration, authenticity, and innovation—you’ll ultimately contribute to groundbreaking science that enhances lives globally and shapes a healthier future for all.


Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.


The **Regional Sales Manager, Key Account Management (KAM) Central US** is responsible for guiding the team to reach targets and develop their professional skills. As a leader within the sales organization, this role is responsible for building and maintaining a high performing technical sales team that can drive customer relationships directed toward growing Molecular Devices’ market share, revenue, and profitability year over year in the following target market segments: life sciences, government installations, biotechnology, pharma, academic research labs, contract labs, and incubator spaces.

**Background**


Zifo is seeking a Junior Customer Success Manager (CSM) to join our commercial team in the South San Francisco region. This position will be responsible for conducting account mining activities with Enterprise Pharmaceutical/Biotech/Life science companies.

**Junior Customer Success Manager Role Summary**


We are looking for an individual who demonstrates strong commitment to proactive account management, maintains current revenue streams, consistently develops the revenue pipeline within the customer portfolio, and fosters successful, long\-term partnerships with our clients.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Partner with Customer Success and Delivery teams in kick starting engagement with new Customers/business areas/products.
* Understand Customer’s tangible and intangible expectations, requirements and ensure they are delivered by Zifo
* Assist in the Management of the Engagement with Customers and Zifo’s internal teams, in alignment with Zifo’s culture and values
* Partner with Service Delivery Management teams in Zifo to ensure transition of projects from Account Mining to Project execution
* Perform active Account Mining by expanding relationships beyond the current set of Customer contacts/business groups and work with the Client Partner on the business plan for success
* Partner in the creation of Requests for Proposals from Customers; Work closely with Zifo team, Client Partners and work collaboratively with cross\-functional stakeholders from Zifo including but not limited to Customer Success teams, Service Delivery Leadership, Product Partnership team, Subject Matter Experts etc., across geographies
* Identify and propose Value Adds, means to realize and ROI for the Customer
* Establish and nurture relationships with Customers, convert them to Zifo Champions and build rapport with multiple stakeholders within our customer portfolio
* Ensure Zifo’s ongoing business with Customers are renewed as appropriate
* Participate in Steering Committee meetings and presentations with Customer Leadership by working closely with Zifo’s Executive Leadership teams
* Provide insights into industry trends and share consultative inputs with Customers
* Proactively suggest best practices internally in Zifo and with Customer interactions in the spirit of ongoing improvements and excellence

 **Requirements** **Required Skills \& Experience**

* 1\-3 years of Customer Success Management / Account Management experience at a Software Services company/Product company or previous consulting experience for Life Sciences
* Strong project management abilities, written and verbal communication skills, and presentation capabilities
* Detail oriented and ability to do multi\-tasking at various levels; Self\-starter and ability to prioritize critical tasks daily
* High attention to detail organization skills and a team player
* Must be willing to juggle many things at once and prioritize effectively.

 **Benefits**  

About Zifo:

new_jobs.title: Sales Development Representative, Outbound
new_jobs.description:
**A Better Built World**
------------------------


At Miter, we’re on a mission to help construction contractors build with confidence. If we’re successful, we’ll make it easier and faster to build critical physical infrastructure \- roads, bridges, utilities, data centers, housing, etc.


For decades, construction and field services contractors have had to run their businesses on outdated software: clunky, on\-premise systems created in the 1980s and 1990s.


That’s where Miter comes in. We’re using AI and embedded payments to rebuild the core HR, finance, and operations systems that underpin our physical economy. Using Miter, contractors like Marathon Electrical, W.J. O’Neil, and Truebeck Construction are building stronger teams, controlling job costs, and accelerating jobsite execution.


This idea is resonating. Since we launched in 2021, we’ve grown to thousands of customers and tens of millions in ARR, making us one of the fastest growing vertical software companies ever. To double\-down on our momentum, we’ve raised $50M\+ from top investors (Bessemer, Coatue, and Battery) who share our belief that we’re just getting started.

**About the Team \& How We Work:**
----------------------------------


Our SDR team is the engine behind Miter’s pipeline growth — and we’re scaling fast. As an Outbound SDR, you’ll own prospecting within a newly established geographic territory model, partnering closely with Account Executives to execute a targeted, scalable outbound strategy across the construction industry.


This is a builder’s seat. You’ll have room to get creative as we shape a repeatable SDR playbook and a high\-impact, data\-driven sales engine, working alongside sales, marketing, and leadership to test new ideas, sharpen messaging, and accelerate revenue growth.


As the first point of contact for many of our future customers, you’ll set the tone for strong, lasting relationships and help contractors see the value of modern, industry\-leading tools. And we’re committed to your growth: SDRs at Miter have a clear path into senior SDR roles, Account Executive positions, and beyond.

**What You’ll Do:**

* Drive net\-new pipeline through high\-volume outbound prospecting — 80–100 dials a day across cold calls, personalized emails, and LinkedIn outreach
* Research target accounts and key personas across the construction industry to craft relevant, tailored messaging that breaks into hard\-to\-reach accounts
* Communicate Miter’s value proposition and business impact, qualifying prospects and booking \~5 direct SALs per month for your aligned Account Executive
* Own the nurture of every prospect all the way through to a completed discovery call and a clean handoff to your AE
* Own your activity and pipeline metrics in Salesforce, and help build a repeatable playbook by testing and refining messaging, cadences, and scripts as we grow the team

**What You’ll Need:**

* No prior experience required — prior SDR work, cold calling, or outbound prospecting is a plus, along with athletic, competitive, or leadership experience
* Strong written and verbal communication, with the confidence to pick up the phone and make a strong first impression with cold prospects
* Grit, resilience, and a strong work ethic — you bounce back quickly from a “no” and bring consistent energy every day
* A natural relationship builder who partners closely with AEs, asks sharp questions, and gets creative about breaking into target accounts
* Self\-motivated and coachable, with a genuine desire to build a long\-term career in Sales
* A true team player above all — you win as a team and lift up the people around you

**Our Interview Process:**

* Recruiter Screen
* Hiring Manager Interview
* Take Home Assignment
* Final Executive Interview

**Our Benefits:**
-----------------

* **Competitive Compensation:** We offer competitive (well above “market”) salary, commission, and equity packages.
* **Medical Insurance:** Comprehensive medical, dental, FSA, vision plans to suit you and your family’s needs.
* **401(k) Retirement Plan:** Company\-matched contributions to help you plan for your future.
* **Flexible PTO:** Take the time you need to recharge and be your best self.
* **Parental Leave:** Generous 16\-week paid leave for all parents, including adoptive and foster parents.
* **Learning \& Development:** We offer every employee an annual educational allowance to explore external professional development.
* **Office Extras:** Snacks, coffee, lunch, and commuter benefits for in\-office Mitosaurs.
* **Community**: Company\-wide and team\-specific off\-sites per year.

**Hybrid vs. Remote Approach:**
-------------------------------


We believe the magic of Miter comes from working side by side. We also believe in work flexibility. For roles that are listed as **hybrid,** our approach is 3 days a week in the office giving us the chance to connect, brainstorm, and build stronger relationships. If you live within a reasonable commute to either our New York City or San Francisco offices, we ask that you work in our hybrid approach.


Otherwise, for roles listed as **remote** or in other cities where we don't have an office location, there is no requirement to work in our hybrid approach. We do travel a few times a year for onboarding, company\-wide and team specific off\-sites!


**Join our Talent Community**
-----------------------------


Not seeing a role that matches your background right now? **Apply to our Talent Community****,** and we’ll reach out if a role opens up that aligns with your experience!

**Equal Opportunity:**
----------------------


Miter provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, genetics, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression. We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and ab

new_jobs.description:
#### **Help make the world more hospitable**

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that's just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we're transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.



You'll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You'll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you'll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we're building.



If you're motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you'll feel at home here.


#### **About the role**



Let's get into the specifics. It's impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:


North American hotel operators are running on legacy, on\-premise technology that creates system fragmentation and manual workarounds across everything they do. This BDR role exists to continue to expand the West Coast market for Mews, building qualified pipeline from the first cold call to the booked discovery meeting.

You will work across the West Coast territory, owning outbound prospecting to hotel GMs, revenue managers, and group procurement contacts. The pipeline you build is the commercial foundation for everything Mews does in the West Coast.

**What you would do**
* Run multi\-channel cold outreach including calls, emails, and targeted sequences to hotel GMs, revenue managers, and procurement contacts, converting conversations into booked discovery meetings for the Account Executive team
* Research and tier new business opportunities in the West Coast market, building pipeline on your own initiative
* Track and report pipeline activity to your direct manager on weekly, monthly, and quarterly cadences
* Feed market intelligence from hotel operators back to your regional commercial team to sharpen targeting and outreach approach
* Utilize AI often to do research and prospecting

**What you would bring**
* Ideally at least six months of experience in an outbound\-facing role where you initiated contact and handled rejection, whether BDR, SDR, inside sales, or a high\-contact customer\-facing position
* Hospitality experience strongly encouraged
* A genuine connection and passion to hospitality, through hotel operations, front desk, reservations, events, food and beverage, or deep curiosity about how hotels work, so you can speak credibly to a GM from the first call
* Clear written and verbal communication in both languages, with the ability to adapt your tone for different decision\-maker profiles
* AI Fluency Level 2 or the equivalent hands\-on experience: deliberate use of AI for outreach research and drafting, consistent review before anything goes out, and full ownership of the result


**AI Fluency Level 2:** In practice, this means using AI to draft and personalise outreach to hotel GMs, giving it real context about the property, the GM's known situation, and the tone that works with hospitality operators, then reviewing and editing before anything is sent. You are actively experimenting with AI sequencing tools and research assistants and building a view on what produces better results with North American prospects. Every message that reaches a prospect is yours.

  

*For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to* *"AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates"* *on Confluence.*


**Nice to have**
* Familiarity with Salesforce and outbound platforms such as Outreach, Salesloft, or LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Deep hospitality knowledge
* Prior BDR or SDR experience at a SaaS company with a track record of hitting activity and pipeline targets

#### **Pay Transparency at Mews**



Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.



This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.



If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process \- your recruiter will be able to help.


#### **What's in it for you?**



Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.


#### **Global benefits**



No matter where you're based, you'll enjoy:


* Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)
* Participation in our company share program
* Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)
* An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development
* Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself
* A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year
* Relocation options, available after one year
* Flexible, hybrid working options
* A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work\-from\-home allowance
* Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working

#### **Local benefits**



You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

new_jobs.description:
**About the Company**


Marcus \& Millichap Company (MMC) is a real estate leader and pioneer with a diverse family of companies offering Real Estate Services, Real Estate Investments, and Real Estate Development. Each MMC company is a distinct fusion of real estate specialization and innovation, powered by a culture of loyalty that permeates throughout the Marcus \& Millichap organization. To find out more about the Company, visit www.mmcrealestate.com.


Please note that we are in a great location, near Caltrain, with excellent restaurants and shops within walking distance.

**Position Overview**


The Executive Assistant is a strategic partner to senior leadership, responsible for optimizing executive effectiveness, managing high\-priority workflows, and driving coordination across stakeholders. This role operates with a high degree of autonomy, judgment, and anticipation in a fast\-paced, high\-demand environment.


The position requires a proactive, highly polished professional who can manage complexity, influence outcomes, and serve as a trusted extension of the executive, while exercising exceptional discretion in handling highly sensitive and confidential information.


The position reports to the Chief of Staff and is based at the Company’s headquarters in Palo Alto, CA.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Executive Operations \& Strategic Calendar Management**
	+ Own and optimize executive calendars to align with strategic priorities
	+ Proactively identify scheduling conflicts, competing priorities, and opportunities for efficiency
	+ Ensure executives are fully prepared with context, materials, and clear objectives
	+ Maintain organized records, files, and documentation systems
* **Executive Meeting, Board \& Event Leadership**
	+ Lead planning and execution of executive, board, and other key leadership meetings, including board and investor interactions
	+ Develop agendas, coordinate stakeholders, and ensure alignment on desired outcomes
	+ Drive follow\-through and accountability on key action items
* **Strategic Communication \& Stakeholder Interface**
	+ Draft and manage executive communications with a high degree of discretion and judgment
	+ Serve as a trusted liaison for sensitive and confidential matters involving senior stakeholders
* **Travel, Expense \& Executive Logistics Optimization**
	+ Oversee complex travel planning with contingency planning and efficiency in mind
	+ Ensure logistics maximize executive productivity and minimize friction
	+ Monitor and improve administrative processes related to expenses and logistics
* **Executive Information \& Relationship Management**
	+ Maintain and synthesize key executive information, stakeholder insights, and priorities
	+ Manage relationships and ensure continuity across executive interactions
	+ Anticipate next steps and ensure continuity in stakeholder engagement
* **Strategic Projects \& Executive Enablement**
	+ Lead special projects and cross\-functional initiatives
	+ Conduct research, build executive\-ready presentations, and drive deliverables
	+ Identify opportunities to improve executive workflows and operating cadence

**Core Competencies**

* **Judgment \& Executive\-Level Decision Making** – Makes high\-quality decisions in complex situations
* **Ownership, Accountability \& Reliability** – Takes full ownership of outcomes and execution
* **Executive Communication \& Influence** – Builds trust and influences across stakeholders
* **Proactivity, Anticipation \& Adaptability** – Anticipates needs and resolves issues proactively

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required
* 5 to 8\+ years of executive support experience, including senior leadership exposure
* Proven experience supporting complex, high\-demand executives
* Exceptional communication, organizational, and problem\-solving skills
* Proven ability to manage highly sensitive information with discretion, judgment, and professionalism

**Benefits Overview**


The compensation plan for this role is commensurate with the skills required for the position. As such, it is comprised of a base salary and an annual performance\-based incentive, which is determined upon individual and portfolio performance.


The Company offers a comprehensive benefits package including:

* Paid Time Off, Paid Holidays, and Paid Sick Time
* 401k \+ Employer Contribution
* Medical (H.S.A./HDHP option \+ Employer Contribution), Dental, and Vision Plan(s)
* Flexible Spending Accounts
* Group Term Life/AD\&D and Voluntary Life/AD\&D Plans
* Long\-Term Disability and Long\-Term Disability Buy\-Up Plans
* Employee Assistance Program
* Fitness \& Wellness Program
* Other Voluntary Plans


Depending on the role, other benefits such as commissions, an educational assistance program (tuition reimbursement), a referral program, and/or a car allowance may be applicable.

Fiver is not a typical after\-school program or summer camp. Through a one\-of\-a\-kind ten\-year commitment, Fiver provides transformational experiences and builds nurturing relationships with youth from systemically under\-resourced communities in New York so that they can create their own positive futures.

We take a thoughtful, personalized approach to building respectful peer relationships, developing the social, emotional, and life skills that lead to positive decision\-making and outcomes for youth, and fostering positive relationships. We are committed to ensuring that all Fiver spaces, communications, and interactions are Inclusive, Warm, Youth\-Centered, Honest, and Intentional.

**Position Overview**

The Educational Program Associate supports Fiver participants as they navigate important educational transitions and explore their future pathways. This role coordinates Fiver’s high school and postsecondary transition programs, provides individualized educational support, develops and facilitates workshops and events, and works closely with youth and families to connect them with schools, colleges, career programs, and other educational and postsecondary opportunities.

The ideal candidate is passionate about educational access and helping young people identify pathways that align with their interests, strengths, and goals.They are organized, relationship\-oriented, proactive, and comfortable balancing direct service with program coordination and administrative responsibilities.
