new_jobs.title: Event & Field Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
Government technology has failed citizens, public servants, and service members for decades.


Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses for counter\-drone procurement to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI\-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks and months, not years.


This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies.


Founded in 2022 and based in New York City and DC, Kaizen has raised $35 million from NEA, a16z, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital.

**Before You Apply...**
-----------------------


This is Kaizen's first dedicated events hire, and it's a build role. Our events have been run part time alongside other responsibilities. We have a conference presence, a set of shows we return to, and a handful of rooms that have worked well, but no owner and no playbook. You'll set the strategy, own the calendar and the budget, and be accountable for what the program produces.


The center of the role is the federal conference circuit: the Washington\-area shows and agency\-facing conferences where our federal buyers gather, the field motion that surrounds them, and the executive dinners and briefings we run alongside them. State and municipal events sit underneath the federal calendar rather than beside it. Kaizen\-hosted events are a real ambition and you'll scope what we should own, but that work follows the circuit rather than leading it.


Events at Kaizen are a growth function, measured against pipeline and qualified meetings rather than attendance. Our buyers are public servants, and how we show up in a room is a direct statement about the quality of what we build. Politics is not a criterion at Kaizen: we don't screen for ideology, and we expect you to build trusted relationships on both sides of the aisle.

  

**Location**
------------


This is a hybrid role based out of our New York City HQ or our DC office. Candidates must reside in New York or DC, or be able to commute to New York City or DC to work out of our office at least three times a week (Tuesdays \- Thursdays).

  

**Who You Are**
---------------

* You've built an events program rather than inherited one, owning the strategy, the budget, the vendor bench, and the measurement
* You know the federal conference landscape, or you'll learn it quickly, and you can tell a show that draws program offices and CIOs from one that only draws vendors
* You have strong taste and can defend it. You've walked a venue and known it was wrong, and you've ended a sponsorship everyone assumed would renew
* You think in pipeline rather than attendance, and you've defended an events budget with something more rigorous than photos and a headcount
* You're comfortable in the operational detail: shipping, badge scans, AV failures, staffing, and the seating chart that determines whether a dinner works
* You're credible with senior government audiences, from a two\-star Army general to an agency CIO to a contracting officer
* You manage vendors, agencies, and production partners by directing their output rather than depending on it
* You thrive with high autonomy in ambiguous, fast\-moving environments, and you self\-generate the agenda rather than waiting for one
* You're AI\-pilled and default to these tools in your daily workflows
* You're emotionally intelligent, thoughtful, and empathetic toward public sector missions

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **Own Kaizen's events strategy end\-to\-end.** Build and run the annual calendar, anchored to the federal buying year: fiscal year\-end, agency budget windows, and the conferences where our buyers actually show up
* **Decide where Kaizen shows up and where it doesn't.** Evaluate conferences and sponsorships, negotiate levels and booth placement with organizers, and be willing to walk away. A defensible no matters as much as a good yes
* **Own our physical presence.** Booth design, demo staging, collateral, and swag that match the caliber of the product, along with the vendors and production partners who build them
* **Run the field motion alongside sales.** Account targeting, pre\-event outreach, on\-site meeting scheduling, team travel and staffing, and the follow\-up that determines whether the show produced anything
* **Own the satellite program around major shows.** Executive dinners, agency roundtables, and closed\-door briefings, most of them in Washington, where the highest\-value conversations often happen off the show floor
* **Land Kaizen leadership on stage and in the content.** Speaker placement, panel submissions, and awards in partnership with Brand \& Storytelling and Government Affairs, with photo, video, and customer story capture planned into the run\-of\-show
* **Scope and build Kaizen\-hosted events.** Define what we should own, whether a summit, a dinner series, or a recurring briefing, and determine whether we host it outright or co\-host with a govtech company, consulting firm, or systems integrator
* **Own the budget and the reporting.** Manage spend and tradeoffs across the program, and build reporting with BizOps that ties events to pipeline, qualified meetings, and cost per meeting
* **Navigate federal ethics rules.** Gift and hospitality limits vary by agency and shift again at the state and local level. Work with Legal to design programs that are both generous and compliant

  

**What You'll Bring**

* 4\-10 years in events, experiential marketing, or field marketing, with direct ownership of strategy and budget rather than execution alone

**Outbound Prospecting \& Lead Generation**

* Research and identify key decision\-makers within clinical operations, feasibility, patient recruitment, digital health innovation, and medical affairs teams

* Leverage account\-based strategies to penetrate top\-tier pharmaceutical and emerging biotech organizations

  

  

**Inbound Lead Qualification**

* Qualify inbound leads from marketing programs, webinars, conferences, and website inquiries

**Discovery \& Needs Assessment**


* Execute structured discovery conversations to understand current recruitment workflows, site training models, and patient engagement challenges
* Map sponsor pain points to ProofPilot's capabilities across feasibility, awareness, recruitment, retention, and site support solutions
* Clearly articulate ProofPilot's differentiated value proposition: white\-label branding, true end\-to\-end platform, holistic patient and site journey visibility, and GxP compliance

 **Meeting Setting \& Pipeline Contribution**


* Schedule qualified product demos and discovery meetings for Account Executives with well\-documented notes on stakeholders, pain points, timelines, and competitive landscape
* Hit and exceed the core KPI: 5\+ net new qualified meetings with ICPs per month
* Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date records in HubSpot CRM on activities, leads, contacts, and opportunity progression

 **Cross\-Functional Collaboration**


* Partner closely with Marketing on campaign execution, messaging refinement, and event follow\-up strategies
* Provide structured feedback from the field on messaging effectiveness, objections, competitive signals, and market trends
* Collaborate with Sales leadership to refine ideal customer profiles, qualification criteria, and prospecting playbooks

 **IDEAL CUSTOMER PROFILE \& MESSAGING FOCUS**


**Target Personas**


* Clinical Operations Leaders
* Feasibility and Study Planning Teams
* Patient Recruitment and Retention Managers
* Digital Health and Innovation Directors

* Inaccurate enrollment forecasting and antiquated feasibility models (only 20% of trials finish on time)

* Award\-Winning: Industry\-recognized solution backed by pharma, patient, and site experts

 **QUALIFICATIONS**


**Required**

* Proven track record of meeting or exceeding pipeline generation and meeting\-setting quotas
* Comfortable with high\-activity outreach and structured, data\-driven pipeline management
* Strong communication skills with the ability to translate complex problems into concise, outcome\-focused value propositions
* Self\-motivated, coachable, and wired for a fast\-paced, competitive environment
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience

 **Preferred**


* Familiarity with HubSpot CRM or similar sales engagement platforms
* Familiarity with clinical trial stakeholders and terminology (e.g., sites, CROs, recruitment vendors, decentralized/hybrid trials, ePRO, eCOA)

new_jobs.description:
Hemophilia of Georgia, Inc.  

Job Description
Position: Grants Program Coordinator Status: Exempt
Supervisor: Senior Director of Policy \& Compliance Work Location: Hybrid Travel: 15% international
Funding: Funding for this position is provided through program (PHS) resources within the organization.
  

Hemophilia of Georgia (HoG) is a nationally and internationally recognized nonprofit organization that provides programs and support services for people with hemophilia, von Willebrand Disease, and other bleeding disorders. HoG is the only agency of its kind in the state and is dedicated to enhancing the health and wellness of the bleeding disorder community by providing excellence in comprehensive health care, education, advocacy, and the support of research to transform lives.
  

Commitment to HoG Culture:  

* Maintain a positive work atmosphere by acting and communicating in a manner so that you work productively, effectively, and efficiently with customers, clients, co\-workers, and management.

  

* Hemophilia of Georgia operates an annual summer camp program for children and teens with hemophilia and other inherited bleeding disorders. Camp is typically held in the summer (which may include the Fourth of July) and runs Saturday\-Friday, and the date changes each year. Camp is an agency\-wide, strategic priority; therefore, all exempt employees must participate. Assignments may include duties at camp, helping campers get to and from camp, and may involve overnight travel. The Director of Camp \& Client Events will provide advance notice to exempt employees of where support is needed. PTO requests during the week of camp are generally not approved; however, PTO requests for extenuating circumstances will be reviewed on a case\-by\-case basis by the Chief Community Engagement Officer.

  

Position Summary
The Grants Management Coordinator provides administrative, programmatic, and operational support for HoG's domestic and international grants, cooperative agreements, or other grant\-funded activities. This role serves as a key liaison with external partners and stakeholders, helping ensure effective communication, collaboration, and the successful implementation of grants, cooperative agreements, or other programs that advance the organization's mission. The Coordinator manages the full grant lifecycle, including coordinating Requests for Proposals (RFPs), administering the grant submission platform, tracking budgets and deliverables, maintaining grant records, ensuring compliance with grant requirements, and supporting reporting, data collection, and program documentation. Domestic and international travel is required to support program implementation, monitor grant activities, and support organizational goals.
  

Qualifications:
  

Required Qualifications  

* Bachelor’s degree in Public Health, Public Administration, Nonprofit Management, or a related field.
* 2 to 5 years of experience in nonprofit operations, grant writing, administrative coordination, or compliance support.
* Exceptional English writing, editing, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to craft clear and persuasive proposals and reports.
* Strong project management, organizational, and analytical skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Word, including budgeting and financial tracking.
* Experience using grant management, CRM, and reporting systems.
* Ability to work effectively both independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Strong cross\-cultural communication, relationship\-building, and diplomatic skills.

  

Essential Functions:  

* Manage the full grant lifecycle, including award administration, compliance monitoring, partner deliverables, budget oversight, and reporting requirements of HoG non\-federal grants and cooperative agreements.
* Lead the development of high\-quality grant proposals, project narratives, logical frameworks, budgets, and other funding applications in collaboration with executive leadership.
* Monitor project implementation and expenditures to ensure alignment with funding requirements, federal regulations, organizational policies, and approved project plans.
* Prepare, compile, and review narrative, financial, statistical, and operational reports for internal leadership.
* Maintain accurate grant records, tracking systems, databases, award documentation, reporting schedules, and communication logs.
* Serving as liaison between the organization and external customers, recipients, and awardee community to clarify, interpret, and resolve issues
* Evaluate the effectiveness of grants management systems and processes; conduct analyses and recommend improvements to strengthen compliance, efficiency, and program performance.
* Collaborate with executive leadership to develop, implement, interpret, and continuously improve grant management policies, procedures, and operational practices.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for HoG’s international grants and cooperative agreements through project execution and building relationships with funding partners
* Implement the planning, execution, monitoring, and evaluation of international grant\-funded projects and cooperative agreements.
* Monitor project implementation, track spending, reconcile accounts, and manage budget revisions for international projects.
* Foster collaborations to leverage resources, expertise, and networks.

  

Additional Responsibilities:  

* Additional duties as assigned by the Chief Policy \& Compliance Officer

As the **Executive Assistant \& Business Operations Coordinator**, you will play a key role in supporting the company’s legal, regulatory, and executive functions. You’ll manage corporate entities, licenses, permits, compliance deadlines, and acquisition\-related activities while providing high\-level administrative support to the President and senior leadership. This role is ideal for a highly organized, discreet, technology\-forward professional who can manage competing priorities, build strong relationships across the organization, and use technology and AI to streamline processes and support a growing company.


**What You’ll Be Doing**


* You will manage the lifecycle of corporate legal entities, including formations, registrations, annual renewals, filings, maintenance, and dissolutions across multiple states and jurisdictions.
* You will oversee liquor licenses, business licenses, food service licenses, hotel licenses, permits, and other regulatory requirements across the company’s properties and locations.
* You will maintain compliance calendars, licensing records, corporate documentation, and audit\-ready files while proactively tracking deadlines and renewals.
* You will coordinate with outside legal counsel, registered agents, government agencies, Accounting, Operations, Human Resources, Business Development, and property leadership to ensure compliance requirements are completed accurately and on time.
* You will support new acquisitions, management takeovers, property openings, and transitions by coordinating entity formations, EINs, state registrations, licenses, permits, and required documentation.
* You will assist with due diligence, M\&A activities, financing, audits, and other legal and corporate projects as needed.
* You will maintain corporate governance records, including organizational documents, resolutions, minute books, cap tables, and organizational charts.
* You will manage the transfer, renewal, and closure of licenses associated with property openings, ownership changes, property sales, and entity dissolutions.
* You will support brand and investor administration, including employee ID setups, annual investor tax document distribution, and maintaining accurate property and business unit records.
* You will serve as a company notary public for corporate and legal documents.
* You will use technology, automation, and AI tools to improve compliance tracking, document management, renewal processes, and recurring administrative workflows.
* You will manage complex calendars, travel arrangements, meetings, correspondence, expenses, and other administrative responsibilities for the President and senior leadership team.
* You will coordinate executive meetings, offsites, and board meetings, including logistics, materials, follow\-up items, and communication.
* You will serve as a trusted liaison between the President’s office, internal departments, external partners, board members, and other key stakeholders.
* You will handle confidential legal, financial, executive, and personal information with a high level of discretion and professionalism.
* You will continuously identify opportunities to improve processes, automate recurring work, and create scalable systems as the organization continues to grow.


**Education \& Experience**


* Paralegal certificate, degree, or equivalent professional experience in corporate or legal compliance.
* Three (3\) or more years of experience managing corporate compliance, licensing, regulatory filings, or related legal administration.
* Hospitality, restaurant, alcohol beverage, multi\-state real estate, or franchise industry experience, highly preferred.
* Experience managing multi\-state business licenses and/or liquor licenses.
* Experience supporting C\-suite executives in a fast\-paced environment.
* Familiarity with state Secretary of State filing systems and Alcohol Beverage Control (ABC) processes.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and document management platforms such as SharePoint.
* Experience navigating state, county, and municipal filing portals.
* Hands\-on experience using AI or automation tools to streamline legal, compliance, administrative, or document\-management processes.
* Active notary public commission, or willingness to obtain one shortly after hire.


**Essentials**



To be a successful candidate, you will need the following:


* Eligible to work in the United States.
* Exceptional organizational skills with the ability to manage a high volume of recurring deadlines across multiple states, entities, properties, and executives.
* Strong attention to detail with the ability to maintain accurate records and documentation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with senior leadership, outside counsel, government agencies, and property teams.
* High degree of discretion and professionalism when handling confidential legal, financial, executive, and personal information.
* Strong problem\-solving and decision\-making skills with the ability to exercise sound judgment and adapt to changing priorities.
* Ability to build collaborative relationships and work effectively across multiple departments while balancing competing priorities.

At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI\-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!

**Your opportunity**

  


At New Relic, we believe in a virtuous cycle where **customer success fuels improved revenue performance**. Our Account Manager role is a pivotal function of an updated pod structure that sits at the intersection of Customer Success, Sales, and Product. Focused squarely on securing and growing our existing revenue base. We are a passionate, upbeat, and highly motivated group committed to exceptional customer loyalty, support, and expansion.



We are seeking an **Account Manager** to join our team and make a positive impact in the continued success and growth of our organization. In this critical role, you will be a driver of retention, adoption, and expansion. Strong leadership ensures positive relationships and alignment across Product, Marketing, and Sales, and Support. If you are passionate about building deep, strategic customer relationships and thrive in a quota\-carrying environment, let's talk!

  

**What you'll do**

  


You will utilize your skills in customer success, renewals, and sales methodologies to exceed customer expectations and deliver value across multiple key performance indicators.


**Drive Revenue \& Retention**


* **Pod Collaboration:** In partnership with the Account Team, you will function as **a secondary seller within a unified pod structure.** This role is essential in supporting the Account Executive (Core Seller) through seamless cross\-functional alignment and collaborative deal execution. You will review areas of opportunity (whitespace analysis), organize and manage enablement sessions with Technical Success Managers, and in partnership with the Solutions Consultants, help drive new growth opportunities for Account Executives.
* **Secure \& Negotiate Renewals:** Build positive relationships with customers including economic buyers, decision\-makers, champions and end\-users, negotiating contracts for direct and partner managed agreements.
* **Mitigate Churn:** Proactively identify accounts running "cold" and/or at risk (downgrades, churn, low BCM Burn Rate) and develop strategic plans to mitigate uncertainty, drive customer satisfaction, increase consumption, and maintain high renewal rates.
* **Deliver Expansion:** Grow revenue at renewal time and throughout the customer lifecycle. Increase Billable Consumption Metric (BCM) for current subscription customers and convert Pay\-As\-You\-Go (PAYG) customers through sub\-account prospecting and finding new upsell opportunities.


**Cultivate Customer Success \& Adoption**


* **Improve Customer Relationships:** Collaborate with Account Executives on accounts at key moments in the customer journey, becoming their voice within New Relic.
	+ Coordinate Customer Business Reviews
	+ Contribute to Account Plans
	+ Complete the Renewal Process \& Discussions
* **Increase Adoption:** Support customer Onboarding and strengthen product knowledge through:
	+ Account Health Checks
	+ Business Value Assessments Enablement Sessions
* **Advocate \& Resolve:** Collaborate with departments (Sales, Operations, Customer Solutions, Legal, and Collections) to resolve customer issues and advocate on their behalf.


**Strategic Execution \& Data Analysis**


* **Value Articulation:** Effectively communicate company messages and our value proposition, both verbally and in writing.
* **Data\-Driven Strategy:** Use strong analytical skills and experience working with data to professionally advise strategy, identify industry trends, and inform economic buyers and decision\-makers.
* **Operational Excellence:** Maintain an accurate customer master record, including buying programs, contract renewal dates, customer contact information, and sentiment. Job Description

**Job Code:** SOOS03

**Job Family:** Sales Representative: Sales Account Management

**Location: East Coast**

**Compensation: $120K \-$200K**

**Job Description**


The Heidelberg Sales Account Manager, Labels, is responsible for developing and maintaining strong relationships with existing and prospective customers within an assigned territory covering East Coast. This position specializes in the Gallus portfolio of label printing and converting solutions, including digital and flexographic label presses, workflow software, inspection systems, and related consumables.


As a consultative sales professional, the Sales Account Manager works closely with label converters, packaging printers, and brand\-focused manufacturing organizations to understand their production requirements, operational challenges, and growth objectives. By leveraging technical knowledge of label manufacturing processes and Heidelberg's label production technologies, the individual develops customized solutions that improve productivity, print quality, automation, and profitability.


The Sales Account Manager \- Labels serves as a trusted advisor throughout the equipment investment lifecycle, guiding customers through equipment evaluations, workflow assessments, ROI analysis, capital equipment purchasing decisions, installation planning, and long\-term partnership development. This role bridges the gap between technical production capabilities and customers' business goals, helping organizations remain competitive in the evolving label and packaging marketplace.

 **Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Identify and qualify prospective label converters, packaging printers, commercial printers entering the label market, and other target customers within the assigned territory through networking, prospecting, industry research, trade shows, digital resources and working collaboratively with the Heidelberg/Gallus sales team.
* Develop and maintain strong, long\-term customer relationships by understanding label production workflows, business objectives, operational challenges, and future growth plans.
* Promote the Gallus portfolio of label solutions, including digital and flexographic label presses, workflow automation solutions, inspection technologies, and ancillary production equipment.
* Conduct comprehensive needs assessments and production evaluations to recommend equipment, software, and workflow solutions that improve operational efficiency and profitability.
* Serve as a trusted advisor by providing application expertise, market insights, and recommendations tailored to customer\-specific label and packaging production requirements.
* Develop and execute territory business plans and strategic account plans targeting key label converters and growth opportunities.
* Achieve or exceed annual sales objectives for label presses, equipment upgrades, software solutions, service agreements, and related product offerings.
* Build and maintain a robust sales pipeline utilizing Heidelberg's CRM platform and sales management processes.
* Prepare and deliver compelling presentations, equipment demonstrations, ROI analyses, and business proposals to executive, operational, and production stakeholders.
* Coordinate resources across sales, product management, applications, service, and executive leadership teams to support complex capital equipment sales opportunities.
* Act as the primary customer contact throughout the sales process, ensuring a seamless experience from prospecting through installation and post\-sale follow\-up.
* Conduct regular customer visits in accordance with territory coverage plans to maintain market visibility and identify new opportunities.
* Negotiate pricing, terms, and contracts in alignment with company policies and approved discount structures.
* Maintain current knowledge of industry trends, competitive technologies, market developments, and Heidelberg label solutions.
* Provide accurate forecasting, opportunity tracking, and pipeline reporting through Heidelberg's CRM and sales reporting systems.
* Represent Heidelberg at trade shows, customer events, industry conferences, and association meetings related to the label and packaging industry.

 **Qualifications and Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Printing Technology, Engineering, or related field preferred.
* Minimum 3\-5 years of business\-to\-business sales experience, preferably within the printing, label, packaging, converting, or capital equipment industries.
* Experience selling capital equipment, production technologies, workflow software, or manufacturing solutions preferred.
* Knowledge of label printing processes, digital printing technologies, flexographic printing, converting equipment, or packaging production is highly desirable.
* Ability to acquire and maintain detailed technical and application knowledge of Gallus label products and solutions.
* Strong consultative selling, negotiation, and relationship\-building skills.
* Demonstrated success in managing complex sales cycles involving multiple decision makers.
* Goal\-oriented and driven to consistently achieve sales targets and business objectives.
* Strong understanding and disciplined execution of the full sales process from prospecting through closing and post\-sale account management.
* Technical aptitude with the ability to discuss production requirements, equipment specifications, workflow efficiencies, and business outcomes with production managers and technical personnel.
* Strong verbal, written, and presentation communication skills.
* Professional demeanor with the ability to establish credibility and confidence with customers and stakeholders.
* Proficient with CRM systems, Microsoft Office Suite, and virtual presentation tools.
* Willingness to travel extensively throughout the assigned territory.

 **Key Competencies**

* Consultative Selling
* Territory Management
* Capital Equipment Sales
* Label and Packaging In

new_jobs.description:
**KEY ACCOUNT MANAGER**


**Serving California, Pennsylvania, Florida, and Texas**

  


**ABOUT THE ROLE**

  


As part of the America’s team, SANY is looking to recruit a driven, forward\-thinking, and highly motivated **Key Account Manager**. With the deep investment and backing of SANY Group, the Americas business expects to grow significantly in the coming years. Critical to this growth is the appointment of a high\-quality **Key Account Manager**. This role is responsible for drive growth and strengthen relationships with large, strategic customers across the United States. This position will be responsible for developing and executing national account strategies, identifying new business opportunities, expanding SANY's presence within key accounts, and building long\-term partnerships that increase equipment sales and market share.



The ideal candidate is a highly motivated, relationship\-driven sales professional with demonstrated success selling heavy equipment, construction equipment, rental equipment, or other capital equipment to large national or multi\-location customers.

  



With current revenues over $500 million, SANY America continues to make strong progress and significant investments in the Americas market; the organization is now pursuing an aggressive growth strategy and is looking to move quickly beyond this initial platform and increase market share.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**


* Develop and grow relationships with key national and strategic accounts.
* Drive equipment sales, revenue growth, and market share within assigned accounts.
* Identify and pursue new business opportunities with large construction, rental, and fleet customers.
* Build relationships with senior decision\-makers, procurement leaders, fleet managers, and operations teams.
* Develop strategic account plans and maintain a strong pipeline of sales opportunities.
* Lead pricing, contract, and commercial negotiations with key customers.
* Partner with SANY dealers and internal Sales, Product, Parts, and Service teams to support customer needs.
* Monitor customer trends, competitive activity, and market opportunities.
* Provide accurate sales forecasts, account updates, and business\-development reports.
* Represent SANY at customer meetings, industry events, trade shows, and equipment demonstrations


**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**

  

* 10\+ years of SAP implementation and support experience.
* 5\+ years of SAP S/4HANA experience.
* Bachelor's degree in Business, Sales, Marketing, or related fiel preferred.
* Must have direct , hands\-on responsibility for managing and growing strategic or national accounts.
* Must have experience managing strategic accounts across multiple geographic regions or territories, rather than accounts concentrated within a single local market or industry.
* 5\+ years of experience in B2B in or national/key account management experience within heavy equipment, construction equipment, or a related industry.

**WORK ENVIRONMENT \& PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS**



REMOTE (FULLY REMOTE)


**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS**
-----------------------



Frequent (50%\+)

  


**COMPENSATION \& BENEFITS**

  


Compensation will be competitive and commensurate with experience. It will include a base salary and an annual performance bonus.


* Medical, dental, and vision
* Paid Time Off
* 401(k) savings plans
* Health Savings Account (HSA)
* Flexible Spending Accounts (FSAs)
* Company paid STD and LTD benefits
* Life Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  


**EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT**

  


SANY America is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other protected status under applicable federal, state, or local law.

  


**DRUG AND ALCOHOL FREE WORKPLACE NOTICE**

  


SANY America is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a drug and alcohol\-free workplace consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Applicants may be required to complete pre\-employment screenings, including drug and/or alcohol testing, as a condition of employment where permitted by applicable law. Testing requirements, employment practices, and workplace policies may vary based on work location, position responsibilities, business necessity, workplace safety considerations, customer requirements, contractual obligations, and applicable regulatory standards.

  



SANY America complies with applicable federal, state, and local laws relating to marijuana/cannabis use, including applicable medical and recreational marijuana laws where permitted. However, applicants and employees are prohibited from being impaired or under the influence of alcohol, illegal drugs, or other prohibited substances while working, operating Company vehicles or equipment, performing safety sensitive duties, conducting Company business, or while on Company property, consistent with applicable law.

* Own the day\-to\-day management and administration of digital content within Confluence.

* Establish and maintain a consistent content structure, taxonomy, navigation, and standards across Confluence spaces.

* Partner with Client Service leadership and Technology teams to identify high\-value use cases for AI\-assisted knowledge retrieval.
* Test and evaluate Rovo responses to identify content gaps, inaccuracies, and opportunities for improvement.
* Establish processes for monitoring and continuously improving AI\-generated results.
* Help define appropriate governance, permissions, and content\-access practices to protect proprietary and sensitive information.
* Train and support Service Teams in effectively using Rovo as part of their daily workflows.
* Expand the use of Confluence and Rovo from Client Service to additional Service Teams across the organization.

**Service Team Enablement**

**Continuous Improvement \& Analytics**

* Use feedback from Service Teams to continuously improve content and the overall knowledge experience.
* Identify opportunities to automate content\-management and reporting processes.
* Stay current on developments in AI\-powered knowledge management, Confluence, Rovo, and related technologies.

This role helps transform Confluence from a static documentation repository into a centralized, continuously improving knowledge platform, while leveraging Rovo to make that knowledge available to Service Teams in real time.

The Digital Marketing Specialist owns website performance marketing for our newest sales channel DTC and our legacy B2B sites, along with the other digital assets that support them. This is a hands\-on execution role reporting to the Senior Director of Business Development. Your focus splits roughly 80/20 between DTC and B2B support. The Senior Director sets content strategy and campaign calendars. You will own day\-to\-day execution across site merchandising, conversion optimization, SEO, site analytics, content, and our other digital assets, partnering with Design, IT, and Sales to get work live. Strategy and the campaign calendar sit with the Senior Director; your input on what's working is expected, and the role can grow into strategic ownership as you build a track record. * Own the execution of website performance marketing for DTC and B2B, plus the campaigns and content that run across the website and other digital assets.

* Demonstrated hands\-on Shopify experience (merchandising, navigation, landing pages, promotions and discount mechanics).
* Working SEO/AEO knowledge applied to live ecommerce pages, with interest in growing into more strategic work.
* Hands\-on GA4 experience — conversion and event tracking, funnel and landing\-page reporting, and channel attribution.

* Ability to collaborate with cross\-functional teams.
* Curious, self\-motivated, and comfortable in a fast\-moving environment.
* Highly organized and able to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
* Exposure to both DTC and B2B content for a consumer brand.
* Background in home décor, furniture, interiors, gifting, or consumer goods.

You'll be measured on:

**Location:** Oak Brook, IL (Office) \| Chicagoland Event Venues

**Primary Event Locations:** McCormick Place (Chicago) and Donald E. Stephens Convention Center (Rosemont)

**Job Type:** Full\-Time

**Salary:** $50,000\-$60,000 per year

Join the AF Services Team

AF Services is a leading provider of event staffing, guest services, and event operations throughout the Chicagoland area. We partner with premier convention centers, trade shows, corporate events, sporting events, and special events to deliver exceptional service and operational excellence.

We're looking for an experienced, motivated leader to join our Operations team. This is a hands\-on management position for someone who thrives in fast\-paced environments, enjoys leading people, and takes pride in delivering outstanding service to clients.

**The majority of this role is spent managing live events onsite.** You'll oversee operations at some of the Midwest's largest convention and event venues, working directly with clients and leading teams to ensure every event is executed successfully.

When you're not onsite at events, you'll work from our **Oak Brook office** assisting with recruiting, scheduling, employee compliance, and operational planning.

If you enjoy the excitement of live events and no two days being the same, we'd love to meet you.

What You'll DoEvent Operations

· Serve as the onsite Event Operations Manager for conventions, trade shows, sporting events, and special events throughout the Chicagoland area.

· Manage event operations primarily at McCormick Place in Chicago and the Donald E. Stephens Convention Center in Rosemont, with additional assignments at other Chicagoland venues.

· Lead, supervise, and support large teams of event personnel before, during, and after events.

· Conduct pre\-event walkthroughs and coordinate logistics with clients, venue representatives, and internal staff.

· Serve as the primary onsite point of contact for clients.

· Resolve operational challenges quickly while maintaining a calm, professional approach.

· Complete post\-event reports and communicate operational updates to office leadership.

Team Leadership \& Operations

· Recruit, interview, and assist with hiring event staff.

· Assist with employee scheduling and workforce planning.

· Review employee PERC Card certifications and required compliance documentation.

· Coach and mentor employees.

· Summarize payroll following events and work with accounting to resolve payroll questions.

· Assist with client meetings and help build long\-term client relationships.

What We're Looking For

· Previous management or supervisory experience required.

· Experience in event operations, hospitality, security, customer service, or a related field preferred.

· Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills.

· Strong organizational and time management abilities.

· Ability to remain calm under pressure and make sound decisions.

· Comfortable supervising large teams.

· Proficient in Microsoft Outlook, Excel, and Word.

· Valid driver's license and reliable transportation.

Schedule

This is a full\-time, salaried position with a schedule driven by the event calendar \- not a traditional Monday\-through\-Friday, 9\-to\-5 schedule. Hours fluctuate significantly, but primarily 2nd shift: lighter weeks may require approximately 30 hours, while busy event weeks may require 50 or more hours. The role regularly includes early mornings, evenings, weekends, and occasional holidays, and some busy periods may involve working portions of several consecutive days. In return, the position offers flexibility during slower periods and between event responsibilities, provided office duties are completed and assigned events are fully supported.

· Combination of office work in Oak Brook and onsite event management throughout the Chicagoland area.

Physical Requirements

· Ability to stand and walk for extended periods during events.

· Ability to navigate large convention centers and event venues.

· Ability to occasionally climb stairs and work indoors and outdoors as needed.

Benefits

· Competitive salary: $50,000\-$60,000 annually

· Health insurance

· Paid time off

· Illinois Secure Choice retirement program

· Professional development and leadership growth opportunities

· Opportunity to work at premier convention and event venues

Why AF Services?

At AF Services, you'll be trusted to make decisions, lead people, and represent our company with some of the region's most recognizable clients. We believe in promoting from within and investing in our people. High\-performing managers have opportunities to advance into senior operations leadership roles as our company continues to grow.

If you're looking for a career where every day is different, your leadership matters, and your work directly contributes to the success of major events across Chicagoland, we encourage you to apply.
